23352478.title: The Perfect Line
23352478.overview: Players compete to get the most correct answers while learning surprising facts and trivia.

47405.title: Crime Beat
47405.overview: Crime Beat is a true crime series that takes viewers deep into some of Canada’s most infamous criminal cases.

episodes.title: Meika Jordan: the Broken Princess
episodes.overview: Crime reporter Nancy Hixt takes you through the case of Meika Jordan, a six year old girl whose life was tragically cut short.

episodes.title: Farah Khan: a City's Lost Child
episodes.overview: Dismembered remains are discovered. They belong to a child. But whose?

episodes.title: The Final Homecoming of Lukas Strasser-Hird
episodes.overview: At 18, Lukas Strasser-Hird’s future was bright. After a year studying abroad, he had aspirations to become a doctor. The day he arrived back home, he went out with friends to celebrate.

episodes.title: Alison Parrott: Leader of the Pack
episodes.overview:
Lured from her home for a photoshoot, a promising young athlete never returns.
Caryn Lieberman takes us through the DNA breakthrough that cracks the case to a mother’s national safety campaign.

episodes.title: Alicia Ross: Everyone’s Daughter
episodes.overview: Alicia’s disappearance leads to one of the biggest missing person searches in Ontario’s history. Reporter Catherine McDonald reconnects with Alicia’s mother to tell the story.

episodes.title: Darkness in the Pass
episodes.overview: Two people dead ...and a two year old child gone missing. A small community in the Rocky Mountains...shattered.

episodes.title: The Legacy of Jordan Manners: Catherine McDonald
episodes.overview: In May of 2007, 15 year old Jordan Manners was gunned down in a hallway at C.W. Jefferys Collegiate Institute, marking the first time a student was shot and killed inside a Toronto school.

episodes.title: If Anything Happens to Me: the Ottey Sisters
episodes.overview: At 29 years old, Lisa Mitchell had a lot on her plate. Lisa and her common-law husband, Allan Shyback, had two children. In the fall of 2012, she juggled two jobs to try to make ends meet and provide for her family.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Lisa Mitchell
episodes.overview: At 29 years old, Lisa Mitchell had a lot on her plate. Lisa and her common-law husband, Allan Shyback, had two children. In the fall of 2012, she juggled two jobs to try to make ends meet and provide for her family.

episodes.title: Kimberley Kasatkin: No Body, No Crime
episodes.overview: Her partner says she left and abandoned the family.

episodes.title: The Brentwood Five Massacre, Part 1
episodes.overview: On April 14, 2014, a group of friends had a small get-together at their home near the University of Calgary campus in the northwest neighbourhood of Brentwood.

episodes.title: The Brentwood Five Massacre, Part 2
episodes.overview: What started out as a party to mark the end of classes at the University of Calgary ended in a horrific tragedy.  . In less than a minute the five victims were stabbed in the biggest mass killing in Calgary’s history.

episodes.title: Who Killed Kelly Cook, the Back-Up Babysitter
episodes.overview: In 1981, Kelly Cook took a job to babysit for someone named Bill Christensen. The 15-year old girl was never seen alive again.

episodes.title: Who Killed Sonia?
episodes.overview: Will new leads solve this cold case? The police say they won’t quit until they find her killer. Police started an investigation into the 42-year-old nurse’s death after she didn’t show up for work at a Mississauga pharmaceutical company.

episodes.title: The Final Chapter of the Christine Jessop and Guy Paul Morin Tragedy
episodes.overview: In a small town outside Toronto; a young girl went missing.

episodes.title: Shannon Madill's Last Audition
episodes.overview: Shannon Madill had everything going for her. She had just landed an audition for a role in a television series, and was looking forward to moving from Calgary to Edmonton.

episodes.title: Karissa Boudreau: Up With the Angels
episodes.overview: Penny Boudreau reported her 12-year-old daughter Karissa missing on the night of a heavy snowstorm in January 2008.

episodes.title: Fatal Facade: The Murder of Dr. Elana Fric
episodes.overview: When the body of 40-year-old doctor Elana Fric is discovered by a passerby out for a walk, investigators know they're looking for a cold-blooded killer

episodes.title: Two Doors Down: The Tragic Case of Mr. Kelloway
episodes.overview:
Craig Kelloway came to Calgary from the Maritimes for new opportunities.
He was a new father, in a new relationship...and had just moved into a new community.

episodes.title: Stolen Second Chances: The Jessica Newman Story
episodes.overview: A Calgary mother disappeared in March 2015. Family and friends turned to police--as it was out of character for the 24-year-old to just take off.

episodes.title: I Survived a Serial Killer
episodes.overview: Two men reveal their experiences with Bruce McArthur.

episodes.title: For No Reason: The Murders of Dianna and Richard
episodes.overview: In 2017 the brutal slayings of Dianna Mah-Jones, 64, and Richard Jones, 68, sent shockwaves throughout Vancouver. Who could have done such a horrific crime?

episodes.title: The Evil and Senseless Plot Against Ray Johnson
episodes.overview: Ray Johnson was a loving father and grandfather. He lost the love of his life to cancer--and also battled cancer himself.

episodes.title: An Enigma: Hiding in Plain Sight
episodes.overview: In July of 2000, 18 year old Tina Wu was murdered and her younger sister Theresa suffered horrific injuries when an attacker broke into their Toronto apartment.

episodes.title: Tori Stafford: Never Forget, Part 1
episodes.overview: The small Ontario town of Woodstock Ontario was the setting for one of Canada’s most horrific child murders. 8 year old Tori Stafford was abducted, raped, and brutally murdered on April 8, 2009.

episodes.title: Tori Stafford: Never Forget, Part 2
episodes.overview: The small Ontario town of Woodstock Ontario was the setting for one of Canada’s most horrific child murders. 8 year old Tori Stafford was abducted, raped, and brutally murdered on April 8, 2009.

episodes.title: The Day Ryan Lane Vanished
episodes.overview: When Ryan Lane broke up with the mother of his child—his world fell apart.

episodes.title: Hunted by Evil, Part 1
episodes.overview: A little boy had a sleepover at his grandparent’s home. When his mother returned to pick him up the next morning—all three were gone.

episodes.title: Hunted by Evil, Part 2
episodes.overview: With a little boy and his grandparents still missing, police make a dramatic arrest. A search of the suspect’s property leads to one disturbing discovery after another.

episodes.title: The Big Lie to Die for
episodes.overview: the home, investigators discover a gruesome scene and identify an unexpected murder weapon -- a crossbow.

episodes.title: Innocent Blood
episodes.overview: After a torso is found floating in the Oshawa Harbour, the family of 18-year-old Rori Hache is horrified to learn the human remains belong to the missing teen.

episodes.title: Remember Her Name: Chantel Moore
episodes.overview: 26-year-old Chantel Moore was shot and killed by a New Brunswick police officer during a wellness check.

episodes.title: Forbidden Love: the Murder of Jassi Sidhu
episodes.overview: While visiting in India, a young newly-wed from British Columbia was attacked, kidnapped, and her lifeless body discovered in a canal the next day.

episodes.title: Arlene Westervelt: Murder or Misadventure?
episodes.overview: A husband and wife are out for a canoe ride on a calm, clear afternoon when tragedy strikes. The boat capsizes and only the husband survives.

episodes.title: “Mr. Murder”: Four Lives Lost
episodes.overview: In the fall of 2010, four men were gunned down in their prime -- shot and killed in Toronto in three separate shootings.

episodes.title: Blindsided: the Story of Mylan Hicks
episodes.overview: A young man who grew up in one of the most deadly cities in North America beat the odds to become a professional football player.

episodes.title: Eddie Melo’s Final Round
episodes.overview: When Canadian boxing star Eddie “Hurricane” Melo is killed, alongside his cousin Joao Pavao, investigators are quick to start digging into Melo’s work as a mob enforcer and his connections to the Montreal Mafia.

episodes.title: The Kindly Cop: Who Killed Constable André Lalonde?
episodes.overview: The family of Constable André Lalonde has searched for answers for 25 years.

episodes.title: Shattered by a Call
episodes.overview: A young Calgary woman goes missing for days. Her grandmother felt something wasn’t right. She called Taylor Toller’s friends and family and even reported her missing to police.

episodes.title: Mindy Tran: the Abduction of Innocence
episodes.overview: On August 17, 1994, in Kelowna B.C., eight-year-old Mindy Tran hopped on her bike and pedaled over to a nearby friend’s house to ask her to play. She was never seen again.

episodes.title: I Heard Her Screams
episodes.overview: Two Eritrean refugees looking for a better life in Canada are murdered. First, 55-year-old Nighisti Semret is stabbed to death walking home from her night shift in October 2012.

episodes.title: Picture Perfect: the Shattered Dreams of Maple Batalia
episodes.overview: In the Fall of 2011, Maple Batalia, a young university student with a promising career as an actor and model, was brutally shot and slashed to death on the campus parking lot in Surrey, B.C.

episodes.title: Justice for Lacey
episodes.overview: A series of 911 calls leads first responders to multiple scenes and the disturbing discovery of a young woman’s body.

episodes.title: A Monster in the Woods
episodes.overview: It was a crime unlike anything ever seen before in Canada. The horror of the "Wells Gray Murders" forty years ago still haunts investigators involved in the case, as well as family and friends of the victims.

episodes.title: Innocence and Evil, Part 1
episodes.overview: Reporter Caryn Lieberman tells the story of the 1994 disappearance of Larry Arnold, a man who went missing from Toronto’s gay village.

episodes.title: Innocence and Evil, Part 2
episodes.overview: Reporter Caryn Lieberman reveals how Larry Arnold’s murder investigation is linked to the 1997 killing of a 20-year-old woman hundreds of kilometers away in North Bay, Ontario. Sarah Whitehead was sexually assaulted and murdered as she left a mall.

episodes.title: A Prayer for Arcelie
episodes.overview: On a cold, snowy winter night in January 2008 an officer was on patrol when a confusing call came in to 911.

episodes.title: The Story Blood Tells
episodes.overview: An in-depth look at how forensic experts examine blood spatter to help piece together what happened at the crime scene – and how it helped secure convictions in some of Canada’s most high profile murder cases.

episodes.title: The Secrets of Salmon River, Part 1
episodes.overview: When 27-year-old Caitlin Potts disappears from the North Okanagan in February 2016, police are puzzled. Although her body has never been found, Mounties believe she has been murdered.

episodes.title: The Secrets of Salmon River, Part 2
episodes.overview: Five women have mysteriously vanished from near B.C.’s Shuswap region over a year and a half, leaving their families desperate for some sort of closure.

episodes.title: Obsessed
episodes.overview: A police manhunt leads to a high speed chase and a life-or-death situation for two officers. Learn the extreme lengths one man was willing to go to and the tragic outcome of his obsession with Nadia El-Dib.

episodes.title: Awaking to a Nightmare: the Rhoderie Estrada Murder
episodes.overview: A caring nurse and mother of three viciously murdered after a break-in at her home, while her 3 children slept in another room unaware of the attack.

episodes.title: In Broad Daylight – the Abduction of Holly Jones
episodes.overview: In the early evening of May 12th 2003, 10-year-old Holly Jones told her parents she was going to walk a friend home. She never returned.

episodes.title: Sarah and Taliyah: Stolen Dreams
episodes.overview: A young mother is found dead in her home; her little girl is missing, sparking an amber alert; police use advancements in technology to find the little girl; her ex is in the spotlight and public opinion points to him, a true whodunnit.

episodes.title: The Hired Hit
episodes.overview: Alexandra Pesic is gunned down in brazen daylight.

episodes.title: A Random Encounter: A Night of Terror
episodes.overview: Annie Hang-Kam Chiu was looking forward to retirement.

episodes.title: The Babes in the Woods
episodes.overview: When the remains of two children are found in Vancouver's Stanley Park in 1953, the public and police are puzzled about their identities; advances in DNA technology help investigators make a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Against All Odds
episodes.overview: A German tourist travels across the world with his family to witness the splendor of the Canadian Rockies; without warning, a chance encounter and a single bullet interrupts their trip and changes their lives forever.

episodes.title: The Tragic Slaying of a Good Samaritan: Rose McGroarty
episodes.overview: When a dismembered body was found, detectives set out to identify the victim.

episodes.title: The Murder of the Millionaire Philanthropist Part 1
episodes.overview: Glen Davis was a multi-millionaire philanthropist, well-known for his generosity; he and his wife donated millions to charities, including the World Wildlife Fund (WWF).

episodes.title: The Murder of the Millionaire Philanthropist Part 2
episodes.overview: Detectives investigate leads in what they believe was a targeted killing; reporter Mark Carcasole reveals the twists and turns in the plot to kill Davis, and just how close to home it was.

episodes.title: Cindy James: Terror in the Shadows Part 1
episodes.overview: For seven years, Cindy James told police she was being stalked; when the Vancouver nurse's lifeless body was found two weeks after she went missing, and no suspects, a coroner's inquest is called in hopes of solving the mystery.

episodes.title: Cindy James: Terror in the Shadows Part 2
episodes.overview: For seven years, Cindy James told police she was being stalked; when the Vancouver nurse's lifeless body was found two weeks after she went missing, and no suspects, a coroner's inquest is called in hopes of solving the mystery.

episodes.title: Beyond a Reasonable Doubt: The Story of Terrie Ann Dauphinais
episodes.overview: Terrie Ann Dauphinais, a young Metis woman, is found dead in her home; her death was deemed a homicide, but no charges were ever laid, and the case went cold; new developments in the investigation lead to a dramatic turn of events.

episodes.title: The Wrongful Confession
episodes.overview: Brant Burke's brother was charged with his murder.

episodes.title: A Monster in Uniform Part 1
episodes.overview: In a small town located less than an hour from Canada's largest military base, a rash of break-ins escalates to assault and then murder; tire tracks point police to someone above suspicion.

episodes.title: A Monster in Uniform Part 2
episodes.overview: When the key suspect in a series of assaults and murders is brought in for questioning, a cat and mouse game unfolds in the interview room and ultimately leads to a shocking confession from a man leading a secret double life.

episodes.title: The Crossfire
episodes.overview: What started as a petty falling out between a group of high school friends led to the creation of two rival gangs; over a decade the animosity between the "FK's and FOB's" gangs grew as did their illicit activity.

episodes.title: Shootout at the Duke
episodes.overview: A dispute outside a Toronto tavern between a jealous boyfriend and several gang members ends in a hail of gunfire, in which a young woman new to the city is killed, and the missing gun turns up in an unrelated crime.

episodes.title: The Search for Theresa Allore's Killer
episodes.overview: Homocide analyst John Allore tirelessly probes unsolved murders in his ultimate quest to uncover the fate of his sister, Theresa, found dead in Quebec's Eastern Townships region in 1979.

episodes.title: The Manhunt Part 1 (Jules Knox)
episodes.overview: A cross-country manhunt ensues when a young Australian American couple is murdered, a much-loved university professor is found dead, and two teens go missing in northern British Columbia.

episodes.title: The Manhunt Part 2 (Jules Knox)
episodes.overview: Two missing teens quickly turn into the prime suspects in the murders of three people, and officers follow a trail of clues across Canada into the vast wilderness of northern Manitoba.

episodes.title: The Second Shift (Nancy Hixt)
episodes.overview: In 1992, loved ones and police go to painstaking efforts to locate 26-year-old Dilleen Hempel after she goes missing while heading home from her new job.

episodes.title: Terror in the Playground (Caryn Lieberman)
episodes.overview: After a man fired a gun on a local playground and seriously injured two girls, outraged parents demanded answers from local politicians as to how to stop the cycle of violence terrorizing their neighbourhoods.

episodes.title: Victims of Love (Jules Knox)
episodes.overview: Days after Stephanie Forster is killed near her home in Coquitlam, B.C., her estranged husband, Luigi Derossi, kills himself, but her brother believes Forster discovered Derossi's notoriety as a serial romance scammer.

episodes.title: My Never-Ending Story - The Legacy of Amanda Todd (Kamil Karamali)
episodes.overview: Kamil Karamali reports on the life and legacy of Amanda Todd, a B.C. teen whose encounter with a cyber-predator triggered years of bullying and whose video about online harassment made her a household name.

episodes.title: The Senseless Killing of Rosemarie Junor (Marianne Dimain)
episodes.overview: Ultrasound technician and newlywed Rosemarie "Kim" Junor is stabbed in the chest by a stranger in 2015, and the subsequent trial results in a verdict that still haunts Junor's family.

episodes.title: A Deadly Betrayal (Nancy Hixt)
episodes.overview: A man scouring for bottles in downtown Calgary dumpsters makes a grisly discovery, and a trail of forensic evidence leads police to uncover a deadly betrayal.

episodes.title: The Story Is Never Finished (Antony Robart)
episodes.overview: Senior crime reporters provide updates on a few stories they previously covered; they share several significant developments -- including a major decision made by the Supreme Court of Canada that's impacted multiple murder cases across the country.

episodes.title: The Hunt for a Predator
episodes.overview: A sexual predator on the loose in the 1970s and 1980s; two little girls are attacked by the "Southwest Calgary Rapist" while riding their bikes one hot sunny day; homicide investigators were on the trail for a killer.

episodes.title: Seeking Justice for Myles Gray
episodes.overview: On a hot August day in 2015, 33-year-old Myles Gray traveled from the Sunshine Coast to Vancouver in his company truck to make his usual delivery of fresh greenery to wholesale florists.

episodes.title: In an Instant: The Neville-Lake Tragedy
episodes.overview: Neville-Lakes' three children were killed by a drunk driver, Marco Muzzo, in a crash in Vaughan back in 2015; the driver, the son of a wealthy family, was sentenced to ten years in jail but is now out on parole while the mother is left grieving.

episodes.title: Chelsea Poorman and the Secrets of a Mansion?
episodes.overview: Chelsea Poorman vanished from downtown Vancouver in September 2020; nineteen months later, her body was found in the backyard of a vacant mansion in one of the city's ritziest neighborhoods.

episodes.title: Nothing is What it Seems: Part 1
episodes.overview: A man walking his dog comes upon a neighbor's garage engulfed in flames; when the smoke clears, a woman is found dead with drug paraphernalia nearby; nothing is what it seems, and police are left combing through a web of lies to find the killer.

episodes.title: Nothing Is What It Seems: Part 2
episodes.overview: A man walking his dog comes upon a neighbor's garage engulfed in flames, and when the smoke clears, a woman is found dead with drug paraphernalia nearby; police are left combing through a web of lies to find the killer.

episodes.title: The Deadly Night Shift
episodes.overview: In 2006, 17-year-old Brigitte Serre was murdered in a robbery gone wrong.

episodes.title: The Deadly Contract
episodes.overview: January 16th, 2006, started like any other for Jack Beauchamp; the financier grabbed a coffee and went to work in his downtown Calgary office; minutes after he arrived, he was shot six times and left for dead on his office floor.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.overview: An elderly Mississauga woman is found dead beside Christmas presents she'd been wrapping.

episodes.title: The Tiny Town Mystery
episodes.overview: When a 20-year-old English tourist suddenly stops contacting his family while backpacking across Canada, his mother tries to raise the alarm; police are slow to respond until an anonymous note prompts them to search a nearby lake.

episodes.title: Sorry I Wasn't There
episodes.overview: An innocent victim, Mila Barberi is gunned down while picking up her boyfriend, Saverio Serrano.

episodes.title: The Long Road to Justice
episodes.overview: The family and friends of Adrienne McColl had no idea the heartbreaking news they were about to get - and the long road to justice they were about to embark on.

episodes.title: Homicide 42
episodes.overview: It was 1am on a cold, wet November night in 2011 when police found Leanne Freeman lying unconscious in a pool of blood; she later died in a downtown hospital, becoming Toronto's 42nd homicide of the year.

episodes.title: Surrey Six: The Gang Hit
episodes.overview: Looking into some of Canada's most infamous criminal cases with extensive archives and intimate family interviews and exploring the lasting impacts on the community and justice system.

episodes.title: Surrey Six: Seeking Justice
episodes.overview: Looking into some of Canada's most infamous criminal cases with extensive archives and intimate family interviews and exploring the lasting impacts on the community and justice system.

episodes.title: A Trail of Blood
episodes.overview: In 1995, 92-year-old Henrietta Knight is brutally beaten during a home invasion, managing to escape but dying months later; a connection appears 20 years later as police find links to a bank robbery, a car bombing and multiple murders.

episodes.title: Hunt for the Wolfpack
episodes.overview: Three murders spark a police investigation into the Wolfpack Alliance, a crew of gangsters running operations connected to Mexican cartels; an escape leaves authorities at a loss and the public looking for justice.

episodes.title: Incendiary Circumstances
episodes.overview: In 2004, a young Calgary family settled in for the evening; at about 9 pm, the husband left for work as a security guard, while his wife stayed home with their two children; in the middle of the night, she woke to the sound of shattered glass and within minutes the entire home was engulfed in flames; after desperate attempts to reach her children failed, the mother managed to escape; senior crime reporter Nancy Hixt shares the unexpected twists the investigation took into who was responsible.

episodes.title: Closure
episodes.overview: Susan Tice and Erin Gilmour are found dead and assaulted; the women don't know each other and both cases remain unsolved for decades; 40 years later, the killer is arrested, charged and convicted thanks to genetic genealogy research.

episodes.title: The Death of Christine Demeter by Persons Unknown, Part 1
episodes.overview: One night in 1973, as Peter Demeter pulls his Mercedes into his driveway, the body of his wife Christine Demeter is revealed; investigators launch an epic investigation and discover a story and cast of characters that is stranger than fiction.

episodes.title: The Death of Christine Demeter by Persons Unknown, Part 2
episodes.overview: A look at some of Canada's most infamous criminal cases that have had lasting impacts on communities and the justice system; featuring extensive archival footage and intimate family interviews.

episodes.title: To Catch a Killer
episodes.overview: Jolene Riendeau, a 10-year-old girl, disappears without a trace from a Montreal neighborhood, she was last seen at a local convenience store; her remains were unearthed twelve years later near a bridge and her parents are still searching for answers.

episodes.title: Murder They Wrote
episodes.overview: True crime novels are often topping best sellers lists; to explore the reason of public fascination with this genre of storytelling, "Crime Beat" sits down with five authors pushing the boundaries of true crime.

episodes.title: The Rainbow Motel Shootout
episodes.overview: Curious about why the owner of an expensive sports car would be outside a notoriously seedy Toronto motel, police knock on the door and are met with gunfire; over the next several hours, hundreds of bullets are fired in the biggest shootout in the city's history; when the onslaught is over, the ensuing investigation uncovers a string of crimes leading back to the elderly owners of a B.C. gun shop.

episodes.title: Double Deception
episodes.overview: Two brothers entered a bank in Saanich, B.C. dressed in body armor and armed with semi-automatic rifles; they demanded money and took everyone inside as hostages; then, instead of escaping with the cash, the brothers paced inside the bank as police arrived on scene before a hailstorm of bullets suddenly erupted resulting in two deaths and many people with their lives forever changed.

episodes.title: Benevolence Betrayed
episodes.overview: Audrey Trudeau moves to Calgary in the late 90's in search of a fresh start following a divorce; then, on the eve of an exciting new opportunity, she suddenly vanishes; her disappearance puzzles her loved ones.

episodes.title: Murder in the Mountains
episodes.overview: A young female taxi driver is found murdered in 1990; investigators work to come up with a viable suspect, but the case goes cold; Senior Crime reporter Nancy Hixt goes through the investigation and shares what finally led to a break in the case.

episodes.title: "He's So Evil"
episodes.overview: Crime Specialist Catherine McDonald recounts the story about of an obsession so deep it led to the death of an innocent child.

episodes.title: Make Him Breathe
episodes.overview: Reporter Mark Carcasole shares Tammy's harrowing story and learns more about the man whose testimony, she says, destroyed her life.

episodes.title: Mad Trapper
episodes.overview: When series of cabins are raided in northern B.C., and then a reclusive trapper suddenly goes missing, police believe the crimes could be connected; as Jules Knox reports, that triggers a series of events that leaves one Mountie dead.

episodes.title: Out of the Darkness (Caryn Lieberman)
episodes.overview: Reporter Caryn Lieberman travels to Kingston to hear from the families and survivors reclaiming their voices in order to tell the story of 34-year-old Yvonne Rouleau, tortured and murdered at the Nozzles Gas Bar where she worked at.

episodes.title: The Investigators (Melinda Breda-Buchanan)
episodes.overview: Homicide detectives investigate horrific murders and work tireless hours to find answers for grieving families.

episodes.title: Deadly Rumours
episodes.overview: In the spring of 2006, Calgary Police receives an ominous call from someone who is worried that a woman is being held captive in a downtown rooming house.

episodes.title: Case Never Closed: Justice for Nicolle
episodes.overview: Marney Blunt looks into a new development in Nicolle Hands' case, who was stabbed in her apartment, and learns why the family may still be no closer to achieving justice for their beloved Nicolle.

episodes.title: 24 Shots, 7 seconds
episodes.overview: In December 2019, 26-year-old Koshin Yusuf was coming home from a night out with friends when he was cornered at his Scarborough apartment entrance and shot 24 times.

episodes.title: 'Die Like the Rest' Part 1
episodes.overview: A Winnipeg teenager is found savagely attacked; investigators arrest a B.C. man who was visiting; years later, another slaying of a teenage girl gives fresh light to old evidence that could help convict a killer.

episodes.title: Die Like the Rest Part 2
episodes.overview: Detectives are slowly piecing together clues from a series of brutal sexual assaults and murders across the country; teenage girls are the target, and police are starting to question if one of their initial suspects was wrongfully convicted.

episodes.title: A Million Dead Ends
episodes.overview: On May 14, 1971, six-year-old Ljubica Topic wandered off while playing outside with her older brother and friends; after a frantic search, Ljubica is found dead just a kilometre away; who did this and why it remained a mystery for nearly 50 years?

episodes.title: Face-To-Face With Evil
episodes.overview: Senior crime reporter Nancy Hixt examines the trail of evidence police uncovered about Mark Mariani, who suffered from Crohn's disease and was found dead after celebrating his medical advancements.

episodes.title: Make Him Breath
episodes.overview: It’s one of every new mother’s greatest fears. You put your child down for a nap, only to later notice muffled cries coming from the bedroom.

episodes.title: Deadly Retribution
episodes.overview: A man walks into an office in midtown Toronto and opens fire; there's panic at the neighbouring daycare and nearby schools, fearing a gunman is still on the loose; when police arrives, they discover the shooter killed two people.

episodes.title: 'Wish I Could Hold You'
episodes.overview: Little Heather Thomas suddenly vanishes while riding a bike in Surrey, B.C.; hundreds of people show up to help search for the missing girl; detectives are stymied until an attentive dispatcher and a security guard offer clues that lead to a suspect.

episodes.title: Death of the Window Dresser
episodes.overview: Looking into some of Canada's most infamous criminal cases with extensive archives and intimate family interviews and exploring the lasting impacts on the community and justice system.

episodes.title: The Strange Disappearance of Marilyn Bergeron
episodes.overview: The family of Marilyn Bergeron searches for answers and reveals some startling theories in the mystery of a young Quebec woman who disappeared in 2008.

episodes.title: Shattered Dreams (Nancy Hixt)
episodes.overview: A highly respected executive chef is weeks away from realizing his dream of opening his own restaurant when he is violently killed; the case becomes a true whodunnit as homicide detectives follow a complicated trail of evidence.

episodes.title: The Melrose Avenue Murder
episodes.overview: After a gunfight erupts in a quiet Saskatoon neighbourhood, several suspects flee the scene and nobody wants to talk about what happened; police follow a trail of blood to an apartment where they find zip ties and duct tape but no murder weapons.

episodes.title: Before My Eyes
episodes.overview: Driving home from work, Royi Flescher could never have imagined what he was about to encounter; when Soula Berdoussis pulled over, she thought she was stopping to help at the scene of a car accident.

episodes.title: The "Mr Big" Playbook

episodes.title: A Recipe for Disaster

103.title: The Simpsons
103.overview: This beloved animated comedy tells the story of the Simpson family and the residents of the typical American town of Springfield. Homer Simpson works at the local nuclear plant, and does his best to lead his family, but often finds that they are leading him. Living with Homer at 742 Evergreen Terrace is loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and pacifier-sucking baby Maggie.

episodes.title: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
episodes.overview: After Bart’s tattoo removal, Homer’s failure as a department store Santa, and a bad day at the dog track, Christmas prospects look dim for the Simpsons. But Homer seizes the day and, with the help of Santa’s Little Helper, blunders home with the best gift of all-something to share the family’s love. And frighten prowlers. A holiday classic!!

episodes.title: Bart the Genius
episodes.overview: After switching I.Q. exams with Martin Prince, Bart is placed in a school for geniuses, and everyone is put to the test. Can Principal Skinner contain his joy? Will Homer survive a night at the opera? Does Bart’s brain blow up?

episodes.title: Homer's Odyssey
episodes.overview: Fired from his job, Citizen Homer becomes caught in a web of nuclear hazards and public safety. An action-adventure tale aflame with danger and municipal code violations.

episodes.title: There's No Disgrace Like Home
episodes.overview: Trapped in a living hell, Homer faces the awful truth: the Simpsons are the worst family in town! An electro-shocking glimpse into the weird world of family therapy.

episodes.title: Bart the General
episodes.overview: Terrorized by the school bully, Bart seeks counsel from Grandpa Simpson, who takes him to a warfare expert for basic training.

episodes.title: Moaning Lisa
episodes.overview: Second grade has Lisa playing the blues solo. Homer seeks tutelage to beat Bart at video boxing.

episodes.title: The Call of the Simpsons
episodes.overview: The Simpsons put the wild back in the wilderness when their RV goes over a cliff and Homer and Bart go for help, get lost and lose their clothes.

episodes.title: The Telltale Head
episodes.overview: Bart pulls a stunt that shocks the entire town, including the new friends he was trying to impress.

episodes.title: Life on the Fast Lane
episodes.overview: Homer's gift for Marge prompts her to take up bowling - and an instructor who teaches "many things."

episodes.title: Homer's Night Out
episodes.overview: When Bart sneaks a naughty snapshot of Homer at a stag party, Homer becomes famous—until Marge finds out.

episodes.title: Crepes of Wrath
episodes.overview: Spy me to the moon! Homer and Principal Skinner send Bart to France in exchange for an Albanian student. While Bart slaves at the Chateau Maison’s unsavory vineyard, Adil Hoxha steals classified secrets from Springfield’s Nuclear Plant!

episodes.title: Krusty Gets Busted
episodes.overview: Accused of a heinous crime, Krusty the Clown finds himself caught in a web of hate and suspicion. A clown alone in a teeming tempest of distrust, with no one to believe him - no one, that is, but Bart Simpson!

episodes.title: Some Enchanted Evening
episodes.overview: Homer takes Marge out for a romantic night, leaving the kids with a sitter - who's profiled on "America's Most Armed and Dangerous."

episodes.title: Bart Gets an "F"
episodes.overview: Bart’s poor schoolwork prompts his teacher, Mrs. Krabappel, to threaten to hold him back in the fourth grade for an extra year. He falls behind while studying for a history test and prays to God for help. That night, a tremendous snowstorm hits Springfield, cancelling school the following day. But when Bart wants to go out and play, Lisa tells him he should stay home and study.

episodes.title: Simpson and Delilah
episodes.overview: Homer learns of a new anti-baldness drug, which he can only afford by cheating on his company health insurance. He grows a luxurious head of hair and is promoted by Mr. Burns. He gets an office with a gay male assistant, Karl, who develops a crush on him. But jealous Smithers discovers the secret of Homer’s success and gets the prescription cancelled.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror
episodes.overview: Tales include a haunted house, a misunderstanding with aliens and a rendition of "The Raven."

episodes.title: Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
episodes.overview: When a three-eyed fish is discovered downstream from the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant, the plant is hit with sanctions. Mr. Burns realizes that if he becomes governor, he could control the regulations and brings in a team of consultants to help him take on the incumbent governor. His campaign event is dinner at the Simpson house where Marge serves Mr. Burns’ own three-eyed-fish to him.

episodes.title: Dancin' Homer
episodes.overview:
The family attends a Springfield Isotopes baseball game, which a boozy Homer livens up. He becomes an official mascot for the team, boosting attendance and the team’s play. But when Homer attempts to crack the big time — the big city ballpark of Capital City — he strikes out. Yet he finds to his surprise that the experience has benefited him after all — his friends now
consider him interesting.

episodes.title: Dead Putting Society
episodes.overview: Homer’s annoyance at his sweet lovable neighbor Ned Flanders grows completely out of bounds, so that when Bart and Ned’s son Todd both show interest in miniature golf, Homer bets Flanders that his son can beat Ned’s — and the loser has to mow the lawn in his wife’s dress. Lisa helps Bart train, using the principles of Zen, and when the big day comes, the boys are evenly matched.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: It’s a Thanksgiving at the Simpsons house with Homer betting on football, and Marge’s mother criticizing everything. Lisa has prepared a beautiful centerpiece, containing her feminist heroes, which a jealous Bart accidentally throws into the fire. Homer accuses Bart of ruining Thanksgiving, and Bart runs away from home, but the family grows frantic with fear while Bart roams throughout town.

episodes.title: Bart the Daredevil
episodes.overview: After seeing a daredevil at a truck rally, Bart discovers his reason for living - a career in death defiance.

episodes.title: Itchy & Scratchy & Marge
episodes.overview: After watching a violent episode of Itchy and Scratchy, Marge starts a campaign to tone down the violence in cartoons. She succeeds, and Itchy and Scratchy become so boring that the children stop watching cartoons. Then Michelangelo’s statue of David begins a tour of Springfield and the same people who supported Marge’s campaign against cartoons now demand that David not be shown.

episodes.title: Bart Gets Hit by a Car
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns hits Bart with a car, and after regaining consciousness, Homer sues Mr. Burns. He invites the Simpsons over to discuss a settlement. Mr. Burns learns that Marge feels Homer is taking advantage of the situation, and he pays Homer nothing. Homer is distraught and wonders if he can still be with Marge.

episodes.title: One Fish, Two Fish, Blowfish, Blue Fish
episodes.overview: The family goes out for sushi where Homer eats a rare blowfish, whose flesh can be poison. Dr. Hibbert confirms Homer only has one day left to live, so Homer makes a list, intending to live that day to its fullest. He listens to Lisa’s saxophone, teaches Bart to shave, has a beer with the boys, reconciles with Grampa and is “intamit” with Marge. Finally, he sits down and waits for death.

episodes.title: The Way We Was
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge tell the kids the story of how they met. We flash back to 1974, where Marge is the object of affection of a class brain, Artie Ziff. Homer joins the debate team to get closer to her. But when Marge goes to the prom with Artie, Homer is left to fend for himself and he walks home in the mud. But when Artie tries to get fresh with Marge, she dumps him and picks Homer up instead.

episodes.title: Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
episodes.overview: Lisa is alarmed to learn that stealing can cost you your soul and grows more concerned when she observes stealing in everyday life, like her father's illegal cable hookup. Concerned for her family’s soul, she vows to no longer watch Homer’s illegal cable. But when Homer invites friends over to watch a heavweight fight, the sight of Lisa staring mournfully from the front yard robs him of his joy.

episodes.title: Principal Charming
episodes.overview: Marge puts Homer to work trying to fix her sister up. Homer rejects various suitors, but when called into a meeting with Principal Skinner, Homer realizes he is an ideal candidate. Homer invites him to dinner, but instead of Selma, the principal falls for her sister Patty. He is so smitten he lets Bart get away with murder at school, while lonely Selma gets even more disconsolate.

episodes.title: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
episodes.overview: Homer tracks down his long-lost half-brother and learns that he, Herb Powell, is a successful auto industry executive in Detroit. After Homer meets him, Herb puts Homer in charge of designing a new car. But when he designs a monstrous car with an enormous sticker price, Homer ultimately bankrupts Herb and his company.

episodes.title: Bart's Dog Gets an 'F'
episodes.overview: Bart’s dog, Santa’s Little Helper, grows more and more out-of-control and is enrolled in an obedience school, whose headmistress, Emily Winthrop, is a firm believer in the choke chain. Santa’s Little Helper is a poor pupil, and when he destroys a quilt Lisa has sewn while at home with the mumps, and eats a giant cookie Homer bought, Homer vows to give him away.

episodes.title: Old Money
episodes.overview: Grampa gets his pills mixed up with those of an elderly widow, Beatrice Simmons. They hit it off and a romance blooms. After taking Grampa to a wild animal park, they discover Bea is dead. A grieving Grampa is surprised to learn that Bea left him $100,000. When the townspeople become aware of this, they show up at Grampa’s door begging to have the money for their own purposes.

episodes.title: Brush with Greatness
episodes.overview: After being publicly humiliated, Homer vows to lose weight. After discovering Marge's old paintings of Ringo Starr, Lisa urges Marge to go back to art school to nurture her gift and Marge wins a prize for painting Homer in his underwear, on the couch. Mr. Burns, who is looking for a portrait painter, hires her but she can’t seem to capture his essence, until she sees Mr. Burns make fun of Homer.

episodes.title: Lisa's Substitute
episodes.overview: Lisa is smitten by her cool substitute teacher, Mr. Bergstrom. Meanwhile, Bart decides to run for class president where he is expected to easily triumph over class brain Martin Prince. When Lisa comes to school one day, she is shocked to find that Mr. Bergstrom is gone. Meanwhile, Bart celebrates his victory, only to realize that neither he nor his friends bothered to vote.

episodes.title: The War of the Simpsons
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge go away for a weekend marriage retreat. They have difficulty reconciling their differences, particularly after Marge catches Homer sneaking off to go fishing. At home, the kids throw a party which gets out of hand, prompting Grampa to start crying. Afraid he’ll get in trouble, the kids begin to frantically clean up. Meanwhile, Homer catches a legendary catfish, General Sherman.

episodes.title: Three Men and a Comic Book
episodes.overview: Bart attends a comic book convention and decides to go in with Milhouse and Martin on a comic book, although none of them have enough money. They soon find that joint ownership is difficult, as none of the boys want to let the comic out of his sight. Bart eventually ties up Martin and fights with Milhouse, until the comic is blown away.

episodes.title: Blood Feud
episodes.overview: When Bart donates his blood and saves Mr. Burns, Homer is upset that Burns sends him nothing more than a thank-you note. Homer writes an angry letter in response, then thinks better of it, but discovers to his alarm that Bart has already mailed it. Homer tries to recover the letter, but fails, and a furious Mr. Burns reads the letter and vows revenge.

episodes.title: Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
episodes.overview: Lisa wins an essay contest, and the entire Simpson family gets to visit Washington D.C. Bart flies in The Spirit of St. Louis, Homer drools on money at the mint, and Lisa gets Congress to pass a bill saving her beloved Springfield forest.

episodes.title: Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
episodes.overview: Bart flies in The Spirit of St. Louis and Lisa gets Congress to save the Springfield forest.

episodes.title: When Flanders Failed
episodes.overview: At a backyard barbecue, Ned Flanders announces he’s opening a new store devoted to merchandise for left-handers. Homer secretly wishes Flanders to fail, and Ned undergoes a series of business reversals leaving the Flanders family living in a car, with Homer the last hope to save the Leftorium. Meanwhile, Bart pretends to be taking Karate lessons, only to be beaten up by bullies.

episodes.title: Bart the Murderer
episodes.overview: While his class enjoys a field trip, Bart becomes a Goodfella under Springfield mob boss Fat Tony.

episodes.title: Homer Defined
episodes.overview: When Homer saves the nuclear plant from a meltdown, he wins praise but feels he owes it all to luck.

episodes.title: Like Father, Like Clown
episodes.overview: At a dinner with the Simpsons, Krusty the Clown reveals he is estranged from his rabbi father. Bart and Lisa explore Jewish traditions and literature to prove to the rabbi that clowning is an honorable profession, and lead Krusty and his father to reconcile on the air.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror II
episodes.overview: Maggie uses one of three wishes; a mind-reading Bart rules Springfield; Homer donates his brain to Mr. Burns' science project.

episodes.title: Lisa's Pony
episodes.overview: Homer fails to buy Lisa a new saxophone reed and she is humiliated at a school concert. To make it up to her, Homer buys her a pony, which lives in the Simpson house. To afford the pony, Homer must get a second job at the Kwik-E-Mart, and he can no longer sleep. Finally, Lisa relents and gives up the pony but keeps her father’s love.

episodes.title: Saturdays of Thunder
episodes.overview: Homer fails a quiz designed to test how well he knows his son. A trip to the Fatherhood Institute convinces him to help Bart build a soapbox derby racer, but Homer’s assistance only makes things worse. Riding a sleek racer designed by Martin Prince, Bart is thrilled to see his father come out to root him on.

episodes.title: Flaming Moe's
episodes.overview: Homer gives Moe the idea for a new cocktail whose secret ingredient is cough syrup. Moe takes the recipe without crediting Homer, and his bar flourishes, attracting the cool crowd and Aerosmith. But before Moe can franchise his operation, a bitter Homer reveals the secret of Moe’s success.

episodes.title: Burns Verkaufen der Kraftwerk
episodes.overview: When the Germans assume control of Mr. Burns' plant, they discover it is not the bargain it seems, and in particular that Homer is a buffoon who dreams of the land of chocolate.

episodes.title: I Married Marge
episodes.overview: In this flashback view of Homer and Marge’s early wedded life, we see their marriage in a casino wedding chapel, Homer’s successful attempt to land a job at the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant – where we learn Smithers’ first name is Waylon – and the birth of Bart.

episodes.title: Radio Bart
episodes.overview: For his birthday, Bart gets a microphone which he uses to play pranks, including convincing the Flanders boys that he is God. He wins the sympathy of the whole town and well-meaning celebrities including Sting, by pretending to be a boy who fell in a well. Then Bart actually falls in the well and nobody cares.

episodes.title: Lisa the Greek
episodes.overview: Homer discovers Lisa's knack for picking football winners, which he exploits. When Homer doubts if Lisa loves him, he decides the result of the upcoming Super Bowl will tell the tale.

episodes.title: Homer Alone
episodes.overview: After a particularly trying morning, Marge has a breakdown and stops her car on a bridge. The family gets her a trip to Rancho Relaxo, a local spa, leaving Bart and Lisa with Patty and Selma and Maggie with Homer – who almost immediately loses her.

episodes.title: Bart the Lover
episodes.overview: When Mrs. Krabapple places Bart in detention, he gets back at her by answering her personal ad as a perfect – but fictitious – lover. After standing Mrs. K. up, however, Bart feels remorse and he enlists the family’s help in letting her down easy. Meanwhile, Homer attempts to cure his foul mouth by means of a swear jar.

episodes.title: Homer at the Bat
episodes.overview: With a homemade baseball bat, Homer rules the company softball team – until Mr. Burns, to win a bet, decides to hire ringers. He recruits professional baseball players who each fall victim to misfortune, leaving the game in Homer's hands.

episodes.title: Separate Vocations
episodes.overview: Scholastic tests show Lisa will not be the saxophone player she dreams of becoming.

episodes.title: Dog of Death
episodes.overview: After lottery fever grips Springfield, the Simpsons discover their dog needs an expensive operation.

episodes.title: Colonel Homer
episodes.overview: After an argument with Marge, Homer runs off to a country-western bar, where he discovers beautiful songstress Lurleen Lumpkin. Homer decides to manage her, leading Marge to wonder if she’s losing her man to a younger woman. But after Lurleen’s successful appearance on a country comedy show, “Yah Hoo!” she realizes there’s no one for Homer but his wife.

episodes.title: Black Widower
episodes.overview: The evil Sideshow Bob reappears, apparently reformed, and wishes to marry Marge’s sister Selma. Bart is convinced that his old nemesis is up to no good, and he finally proves that Bob intends to murder his new bride for the money.

episodes.title: The Otto Show
episodes.overview: After a riotous visit to Springfield by Spinal Tap, bus driver Otto loses his license. He moves in with the Simpsons, who lean on Marge’s sisters at the DMV to help him get his job back.

episodes.title: Bart's Friend Falls in Love
episodes.overview: After a sex education class at Springfield Elementary, Milhouse falls in love with a beautiful new girl, Samantha Stanky. Bart’s jealousy drives them apart, landing Samantha in a Catholic school. Meanwhile, Homer tries to suppress his appetite while he sleeps but instead increases his vocabulary.

episodes.title: Brother Can You Spare Two Dimes
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns discovers that Homer is sterile, and placates him with an award presented by Joe Frazier.

episodes.title: Kamp Krusty
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa go off for the summer to Krusty's camp for kids, but instead of meeting Krusty they meet his bean-counting surrogate, Mr. Black. With their children gone, Homer and Marge enjoy a romantic summer, but Bart and Lisa are put to work making crummy merchandise, until Krusty returns and sets things right - by taking the kids to Tijuana.

episodes.title: A Streetcar Named Marge
episodes.overview: Marge wins the lead in a musical production of "A Street Named Desire." While rehearsing, Marge sticks Maggie in the Ayn Rand Day Care Center, where her pacifier is immediately taken from her.

episodes.title: Homer the Heretic
episodes.overview: Homer decides not to go to church one Sunday and has the greatest morning of his life. He continues to avoid services, causing Marge to worry about the fate of his soul. Then, one Sunday, Homer inadvertently burns the house down, and is saved by the heroism of the local fire department, manned by volunteers of all faiths.

episodes.title: Lisa the Beauty Queen
episodes.overview: After a caricature artist does an unflattering portrait of Lisa, she enters a junior beauty pageant to regain her self-esteem.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror III
episodes.overview: A Krusty the Clown doll goes berserk in the Simpson home, Marge is wooed by a giant ape, and Lisa's attempt to bring back her dead cat turns the town of Springfield into a pack of marauding zombies.

episodes.title: Itchy and Scratchy: The Movie
episodes.overview: When Bart's negligence sends Maggie careening down the street in a runaway car, Homer forbids Bart from seeing the new film about Itchy and Scratchy.

episodes.title: Marge Gets a Job
episodes.overview: Marge gets a job at the nuclear plant, where Mr. Burns develops a crush on her. He kidnaps her idol, Tom Jones, in a futile attempt to win her away from Homer. Meanwhile, Bart becomes the boy who cried "wolf" - literally

episodes.title: New Kid on the Block
episodes.overview: A single mom moves in next door to the Simpsons, with a teenage daughter with whom Bart falls in love. Unfortunately for him, she has a crush on Jimbo Jones. Meanwhile, Homer sues an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant when it won’t let him eat all he can eat.

episodes.title: Mr. Plow
episodes.overview: Homer starts a thriving snowplow business, only to have his best friend Barney start a rival service, complete with commercials featuring Linda Ronstadt. Homer is so jealous he sends Barney into an avalanche and certain death, then repents and risks his own life to save his friend's.

episodes.title: Lisa's First Word
episodes.overview: In a flashback, we see the birth of Lisa and young Bart's jealousy towards her.

episodes.title: Homer's Triple Bypass
episodes.overview: Homer must get a bypass operation, but is only able to afford the cut-rate doctor, Nick Riviera.

episodes.title: Marge vs. the Monorail
episodes.overview: A fast-talking con man, Lyle Lanley, sells the people of Springfield a monorail, and Homer is thrilled to be the conductor. Marge warns that the monorail is a mistake, and is proven correct when it speeds out of control, with a VIP passenger aboard.

episodes.title: Selma's Choice
episodes.overview: A death sends the Simpsons to a funeral, and makes Selma wonder if she should have a child.

episodes.title: Brother from the Same Planet
episodes.overview: When Homer is late picking Bart up from soccer, Bart decides to get a "Big Brother" who'll take care of him. Out of jealousy, Homer gets a "Little Brother."

episodes.title: I Love Lisa
episodes.overview: Feeling sorry for luckless classmate Ralph Wiggum, Lisa gives him a valentine. He develops a huge crush on her, which ends unhappily when she tells him that she doesn't reciprocate on a Krusty the Clown anniversary special. Ralph's dad, Police Chief Wiggum, takes vengeance on Homer, but in the end the kids agree to be friends.

episodes.title: Duffless
episodes.overview: When Homer's arrested for a DUI, he uses the opportunity to find out what life is like without beer.

episodes.title: Last Exit to Springfield
episodes.overview: Lisa needs braces and Mr. Burns tries to remove the dental plan from the employees' benefits.

episodes.title: So It's Come to This: A Simpsons Clip Show
episodes.overview: In this April Fool's Day-themed clip show, Bart shakes up a bottle of beer, intending to soak Homer, but winds up putting his father into a coma. The family reminisces about the past while waiting at Homer's bedside.

episodes.title: The Front
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa write Itchy & Scratchy cartoons using Grampa to submit them to the studio. But when one wins an award, Grampa is appalled to see what he has been putting his name on. Also, contains a short, short feature entitled "The Adventures of Ned Flanders."

episodes.title: Whacking Day
episodes.overview: Springfield engages in an annual ritual of whacking at snakes with sticks - a ritual Lisa is determined to stop. Meanwhile, Bart is kicked out of school after a prank and home-schooled by Marge.

episodes.title: Marge in Chains
episodes.overview: Marge inadvertently shoplifts from the Kwik-E-Mart and is sent to a women's prison, leaving the family to fend for themselves.

episodes.title: Krusty Gets Kancelled
episodes.overview: A rival TV show starring an incredibly talented ventriloquist's dummy goes on opposite Krusty, and he is taken off the air. Bart and Lisa decide he must do a comeback special to save his career. They enlist the help of celebrities and the special is a huge success.

episodes.title: Homer's Barbershop Quartet
episodes.overview: While at a flea market, the Simpsons discover an old barbershop quartet album starring Homer. Homer reveals that he was once a singer / songwriter for a popular group known as The Be Sharps, whose rise and fall eerily paralleled that of The Beatles.

episodes.title: Cape Feare
episodes.overview: An anonymous letter writer makes ominous threats to Bart. The Simpsons discover they were sent by Sideshow Bob who, when released from prison, harasses the Simpsons and then attempts to kill Bart with a machete. But Bob's vanity foils him yet again.

episodes.title: Homer Goes to College
episodes.overview: Homer must return to college in order to keep his position at the nuclear plant. He tries to turn his collegiate experience into a rowdy riot and nearly ruins the life of his kind, understanding dean - not to mention his three nerdy tutors, Gary, Doug and Benjamin.

episodes.title: Rosebud
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns has a birthday celebration featuring a performance by The Ramones. Yet he is despondent, pining for his last childhood teddy bear, Bobo. Meanwhile Maggie gets Bobo from Bart who finds it in a bag of ice. This leads to a furious struggle between Mr. Burns and the baby for ownership of the bear.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror IV
episodes.overview: Homer sells his soul, Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner, Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

episodes.title: Marge on the Lam
episodes.overview: Marge goes out on a girls' night with the next-door neighbor Ruth Powers. When Chief Wiggum attempts to pull Ruth over, she flees and reveals she stole the car from her ex-husband. Pursued by the cops, they drive over a chasm - only to land safely on a pile of garbage.

episodes.title: Bart's Inner Child
episodes.overview: Homer buys a trampoline which injures many of the neighborhood children. To avoid future impulsive behavior on Homer's part, Marge orders a videotape to help them communicate better. Brad Goodman, the tape's host, comes to Springfield and recommends the townspeople should all get in touch with their inner child, like Bart - with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Boy Scoutz N the Hood
episodes.overview: Bart and Millhouse join the boy scouts. Homer and Ned accompany the scouts on a rafting trip.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Homer
episodes.overview: Homer is attracted to a sexy co-worker with a personality identical to his own.

episodes.title: $pringfield
episodes.overview: Springfield legalizes gambling, leading Mr. Burns to open a casino and Marge to become an addict. Mr. Burns grows more like Howard Hughes, while Bart turns his treehouse into a Vegas-style resort, complete with Singer Robert Goulet.

episodes.title: Homer the Vigilante
episodes.overview: Homer leads a mob of vigilantes to catch a thief but are unable to succeed until they learn from Grampa that their nemesis is actually an old man.

episodes.title: Bart Gets Famous
episodes.overview: Krusty the Clown hires Bart as an assistant, and a sketch catapults him to celebrity.

episodes.title: Homer and Apu
episodes.overview: Homer goes undercover to reveal that Apu is selling tainted meat at his convenience store. Apu loses his job, and lives with the Simpsons until he and Homer go to India to appeal to the head of the Kwik-E-Mart corporation. Featuring the Emmy-nominated song "Who Needs The Kwik-E-Mart?"

episodes.title: Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
episodes.overview: Lisa gets upset by the sexism displayed by a talking Malibu Stacy Doll. She tracks down the creator of the doll with the aid of Springfield's biggest Malibu Stacy collector, Mr. Smithers. A new doll is created, modeled on Lisa, but proves unpopular.

episodes.title: Deep Space Homer
episodes.overview: In an attempt to send an average man into space, Homer and Barney are recruited as astronauts. Homer is sent into orbit on a voyage with Apollo 11 veteran Buzz Aldrin. Homer saves the mission from disaster, but is dismayed when all the credit goes to an inanimate carbon rod.

episodes.title: Homer Loves Flanders
episodes.overview: Flanders invites Homer to go with him to a football game and even gives him the game ball. Homer decides he's been too hard on his neighbor and is overly kind to Ned, which Ned finds increasingly aggravating. But in the end, the natural order of the Simpsons universe reasserts itself.

episodes.title: Bart Gets an Elephant
episodes.overview: Bart wins an elephant in a radio giveaway. The elephant, which Bart names Stampy, turns out to be ill-behaved and uncontrollable, and the other Simpson pets feel neglected. Finally, the family places the petulant pachyderm in an animal refuge.

episodes.title: Burns' Heir
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns holds auditions for an heir, and after Bart vandalizes his mansion, the old man chooses him. Mr. Burns tutors his protégé in all his evil ways, but when forced to choose between his patron and his family, Bart chooses the latter.

episodes.title: Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
episodes.overview: Bart's dog gets loose in the school, and the ensuing havoc is so great, Principle Skinner loses his job. Ned Flanders replaces Skinner and Skinner returns to the army, but when Flanders brings his Christianity into the public school, a guilty Bart is able to get Flanders fired and get Skinner his old job back.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Knew Too Much
episodes.overview: Bart plays hooky and witnesses a dispute between a waiter and Mayor Quimby's spoiled nephew Freddy. Freddy is accused of beating the waiter, and goes on trial, with Homer enjoying himself in the jury. Bart can exonerate the accused - but only by admitting he skipped school.

episodes.title: Lady Bouvier's Lover
episodes.overview: Marge's mother is wooed by both Homer's father and Homer's boss.

episodes.title: Secrets of a Successful Marriage
episodes.overview: Homer goes to take an adult education class, but decides to teach one instead. He reveals intimate secrets about his marriage which, when Marge learns about them, infuriate her. Homer moves into Bart's treehouse until Marge's wealth dies down - which it finally does when he pledges not to betray her again.

episodes.title: Bart of Darkness
episodes.overview: During a very hot summer, Homer installs a pool in the Simpson backyard. Bart breaks his leg attempting to dive into it, and is unable to use the pool while all the other neighborhood kids do. In a scene reminiscent of Rear Window, Bart sees Ned Flanders bury something he thinks is Ned's wife Maude, but it turns out to merely be Maude's favorite plant.

episodes.title: Lisa's Rival
episodes.overview: A new student joins Lisa's class, and quickly becomes a rival to Lisa, both intellectually and musically. The competition between the two heats up to the point where Lisa enlists Bart to sabotage one of her rival's projects. Meanwhile, Homer takes 100 pounds of sugar from an overturned truck and makes grandiose plans for it until a rainstorm makes the sugar melt away forever.

episodes.title: Another Simpsons Clip Show
episodes.overview: Marge is inspired by the book "The Bridges of Madison County" to try to teach her children about romance. She describes her near-affair with bowling instructor Jacques while Homer relates his almost-fling with co-worker Mindy. They conclude by realizing they lucked out with each other, while the kids watch "Itchy & Scratchy."

episodes.title: Itchy & Scratchyland
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa ask their parents to take them to Itchy & ScratchyLand– the "violentest place on earth." While there, Homer and Bart are arrested, and malfunctioning Itchy & Scratchy robots attack the Simpsons, a la Westworld. They escape with their lives and conclude it was indeed an entertaining vacation.

episodes.title: Sideshow Bob Roberts
episodes.overview: Sideshow Bob runs for mayor as the candidate of Springfield's Republican party. He wins and attempts to construct a freeway overpass where the Simpson home stands.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror V
episodes.overview: The Simpsons are employed on Mr. Burns' country estate – and Homer goes insane. Homer's attempts to repair a toaster lead him repeatedly back into the past – and he inadvertently changes the future. The school cafeteria turns to an unusual source of food –and schoolchildren start mysteriously disappearing.

episodes.title: Bart's Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Bart begins a romance with Jessica Lovejoy, the misbehaving daughter of the local minister. He is blamed and ostracized for her theft of money from the church collection plate. It is left to Lisa to prove Bart's innocence and clear his name.

episodes.title: Lisa On Ice
episodes.overview: Blessed with a natural ability to stop flying objects, Lisa becomes a hockey goalie. Bart plays for another team, and the rivalry between them grows, culminating in a climactic game between the two – which ends appropriately in a tie.

episodes.title: Homer Badman
episodes.overview: While driving the Simpsons' baby-sitter home, Homer notices a gummy Venus de Milo stuck to her rear, and grabs it. His actions are mistaken for an inappropriate sexual advance, and Homer is vilified around town. Fortunately, a secret tape made by Groundskeeper Willie is able to prove Homer's innocence.

episodes.title: Grandpa vs. Sexual Inadequacy
episodes.overview: Marge and Homer's sex life hits a rough patch, but Grampa perks things up with a homemade revitalizing tonic. He and Homer go on the road to sell their elixir, and Grampa reveals that Homer's conception was not planned. Homer vows to be a better father to his own children, then realizes that Grampa did care about him after all.

episodes.title: Fear of Flying
episodes.overview: Homer is awarded free airline tickets only to discover that Marge is afraid to fly. Marge enlists the aid of a therapist, Dr. Zweig. With the doctor's help, Marge realizes her phobia comes from a youthful trauma involving her father, and she is cured.

episodes.title: Homer the Great
episodes.overview: Homer becomes the leader of a Masonic cult with immense secret power, known as The Stonecutters. However, the group soon tires of Homer and bans him from their activities.

episodes.title: And Maggie Makes Three
episodes.overview: Homer explains the story of Maggie's birth.

episodes.title: Bart's Comet
episodes.overview: As punishment for a prank, Bart must assist Principal Skinner with his astronomy. He discovers a comet, which turns out to be on a collision course with Earth. Springfield residents pile into Ned Flanders' bomb shelter, but when there isn't enough room inside, they pile out – and watch the underwhelming comet destroy only the bomb shelter, nothing else.

episodes.title: Homie the Clown
episodes.overview: Krusty opens a clown college in which Homer enrolls. Homer is not a great clown, but looks remarkably like Krusty, leading to many life-enhancing opportunities – until he is captured by mobsters who have loaned money to Krusty.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Australia
episodes.overview: Bart visits Australia to apologize for a $900 collect call, and moons the Prime Minister instead.

episodes.title: Homer vs. Patty and Selma
episodes.overview: Homer runs up a debt that he can only repay by borrowing money from Marge's sisters. Patty and Selma constantly humiliate him until he finds a way to get them to forgive their loan. Meanwhile, Bart takes ballet and is surprisingly good.

episodes.title: A Star Is Burns
episodes.overview: Film Critic Jay Sherman comes to Springfield for a local film festival. Entries include an artistic effort by Barney, an overproduced piece of propaganda from Mr. Burns, and Homer's favorite, Moleman getting hit in the crotch with a football.

episodes.title: Lisa's Wedding
episodes.overview: A fortuneteller predicts Lisa's engagement and wedding to a fellow student from an upper-crust British family.

episodes.title: Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
episodes.overview: The Simpsons' dog impregnates another greyhound, leaving the Simpsons with a litter of 25 puppies. Mr. Burns attempts to get the little dogs for purposes which turn out to be quite nefarious. Featuring the musical number "See My Vest."

episodes.title: The PTA Disbands
episodes.overview: When Principal Skinner implements new budget cutbacks at Springfield Elementary, the teachers go on strike. Lisa and even Bart start to miss the school, and local parents must step in to teach the classes. Finally, Skinner is able to give the teachers a raise by using school space to house local convicts.

episodes.title: Round Springfield
episodes.overview: Bart gets appendicitis from a box of Krusty-O's cereal. While visiting him in the hospital, Lisa is dismayed to discover that her idol, jazzman Bleeding Gums Murphy, is also being treated there. When Bleeding Gums dies, a distraught Lisa gets a local radio station to play his album in tribute.

episodes.title: The Springfield Connection
episodes.overview: Marge confronts a street hustler who takes $20 from Homer, and enjoys it so much she decides to become a cop. She discovers the work is not as much fun as she anticipated – at one point she must even arrest her husband. Finally, after witnessing corruption within the ranks of Springfields' finest, she resigns.

episodes.title: Lemon of Troy
episodes.overview: When a popular Springfield lemon tree is stolen by kids from Shelbyville, Bart vows to get it back.

episodes.title: Who Shot Mr. Burns? - Part I
episodes.overview: After Mr. Burns attempts to take oil from beneath the school and enrages local residents, he is mysteriously shot in the chest - and there is no shortage of suspects.

episodes.title: Who Shot Mr. Burns? - Part II
episodes.overview: In the conclusion of the cliff-hanger which ended season six, we learn the identity of Mr. Burns’ mysterious assailant. The culprit turns out to be the sweetest little suspect of all.

episodes.title: Radioactive Man
episodes.overview: A movie based on comic book character Radioactive Man is filmed in Springfield. Much to Bart’s chagrin, the coveted part of the hero’s sidekick, Fallout Boy, goes not to him but to Milhouse.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Homediddly-Dum-Doodily
episodes.overview: After a series of misadventures, the Simpson children are put in the custody of Ned and Maude Flanders. Learning that none of the children have been baptized, Ned sets up a baptism — which Homer and Marge thwart just in time.

episodes.title: Bart Sells His Soul
episodes.overview: After perpetrating a prank on the First Church of Springfield, Bart sells his soul to Milhouse for five dollars. Bart comes to regret his decision, and goes on a desperate quest to regain his soul. In the end, he gets it back with the help of an unexpected source.

episodes.title: Lisa the Vegetarian
episodes.overview: After a trip to a petting zoo, Lisa is unable to eat lamb. This exposes her to ridicule and resentment from her father and friends. But with help from vegetarians such as Apu and Paul and Linda McCartney, she stays true to her new path.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror VI
episodes.overview: Advertising logos attack Springfield, Groundskeeper Willie terrorizes Springfield school children in their dreams, and Homer enters a terrifying three-dimensional world.

episodes.title: King-Size Homer
episodes.overview: Homer gains weight in order to claim a disability and work at home. But then he finds that he cannot fit into his clothes and his life is falling apart — the only thing he is good for is sealing leaks at the nuclear power plant with his gigantic butt.

episodes.title: Mother Simpson
episodes.overview: Homer’s mother returns to the Simpsons. The family learns that she was a radical in the 1960s who fled town after destroying Mr. Burns’ germ warfare lab.

episodes.title: Sideshow Bob's Last Gleamings
episodes.overview: The Simpsons’ nemesis, Sideshow Bob, returns to threaten Springfield with a nuclear bomb. Then Bob tries to destroy Krusty with the Wright Brothers’ plane, but fails yet again.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Troy McClure hosts this retrospective featuring never-before-seen clips and outtakes from “The Simpsons.” Troy also answers viewer mail and reveals alternate endings for the “Who Shot Mr. Burns?”cliff-hanger.

episodes.title: Marge Be Not Proud
episodes.overview: The Simpsons go to the local mall to get a family photo taken, but Bart is arrested for shoplifting. His mother’s disappointment in him is extreme, and a dismayed Bart desperately tries to win back her respect.

episodes.title: Team Homer
episodes.overview: Homer organizes a bowling team, but is forced to include Mr. Burns in order to raise the money for the entry fee. Meanwhile, Bart wears a sassy T-shirt to school, leading Principal Skinner to institute a dress code.

episodes.title: Two Bad Neighbors
episodes.overview: Former President George H.W. Bush buys a home across the street from the Simpsons. Bush takes a disliking to Bart and spanks him, leading to a fistfight between Homer and the 41st president.

episodes.title: Scenes from the Class Struggle in Springfield
episodes.overview: Marge buys a Chanel suit at a discount and is invited to join a country club.  At the club, Homer discovers that Mr. Burns cheats at golf, while Marge discovers she doesn’t really fit in with upper-class life.

episodes.title: Bart the Fink
episodes.overview: Bart’s attempt to get Krusty’s autograph inadvertently leads to Krusty’s indictment for tax evasion. Krusty fakes his death, but he is tracked down by Bart, who convinces him to return to society

episodes.title: Lisa the Iconoclast
episodes.overview: Lisa discovers that Jebediah Springfield, the founder of her town, was in reality a terrible man. But she decides to keep her findings secret to protect the town’s image of its hero.

episodes.title: Homer the Smithers
episodes.overview: An overworked Smithers takes a vacation and is replaced by Homer. Burns decides he no longer needs Smithers and fires him upon his return. But when Burns falls out a window after a fight between Homer and Smithers, he becomes dependent upon his long-time aide once again.

episodes.title: The Day the Violence Died
episodes.overview: Bart meets Chester J. Lampwick, the actual creator of Itchy and Scratchy. When Lampwick, with Bart and Lisa’s help, wins a suit against Itchy & Scratchy Studios, they are forced to shut down and cease production of their cartoon.

episodes.title: A Fish Called Selma
episodes.overview: Actor Troy McClure marries Marge’s sister in order to conceal a peculiar sexual fetish of his from the world. But in the end, she decides she would rather not remain in a loveless union.

episodes.title: Bart On the Road
episodes.overview: While spending time with his aunts at the Department of Motor Vehicles, Bart creates a fake driver’s license. He uses it to rent a car and drive to Knoxville, Tennessee, thinking it is still hosting the World’s Fair, and he must be rescued by Lisa and Homer.

episodes.title: 22 Short Films About Springfield
episodes.overview: In a series of short, interconnected stories featuring various Springfielders, we see, among other things, Principal Skinner invite Superintendent Chalmers over for dinner, Maggie get locked in a newspaper box, and Nelson the bully get a taste of his own medicine.

episodes.title: Raging Abe Simpson and His Grumbling Grandson in "the Curse of the Flying Hellfish"
episodes.overview: Grampa reveals that he stands to inherit a small fortune as the last survivor of his old army unit — assuming Mr. Burns dies before he does. Mr. Burns and Grampa tussle over the treasure, until the U.S. government arrives on the scene to return it to its true owner.

episodes.title: Much Apu About Nothing
episodes.overview: Springfield passes an ordinance outlawing illegal immigrants. Apu is worried that he will be deported and tries desperately to pass a citizenship test.

episodes.title: Homerpalooza
episodes.overview: Homer accompanies popular rock bands around the country, entertaining audiences by catching cannonballs in his stomach. When the show gets to Springfield, however, Homer decides to quit for the sake of his family.

episodes.title: Summer of 4 Ft. 2
episodes.overview: The Simpsons rent a summer cottage. Hanging around with a new set of kids, Lisa becomes popular, while Bart is uncool and nerdy. Bart tries to sabotage his sister’s newfound acceptance, but fails.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror VII
episodes.overview: In this annual terror-themed trilogy, Bart and Lisa discover an evil creature living in the attic, Lisa inadvertently creates a miniature civilization, and aliens Kang and Kodos run for President of the United States.

episodes.title: You Only Move Twice
episodes.overview: Homer gets a new job and the family moves—only to find out his new employer is an evil millionaire intent on ruling the world.

episodes.title: The Homer They Fall
episodes.overview: Homer displays an amazing ability to take a punch, which spurs Moe to urge Homer to become a professional boxer. But when Homer is about to be killed by heavyweight champion Drederick Tatum, Moe decides they’ve had enough.

episodes.title: Burns, Baby Burns
episodes.overview: The Simpsons are amazed to discover that Mr. Burns has a long-lost son, Larry. Mr. Burns is slow to embrace his offspring, and despite Homer’s best attempts, they do not reconcile.

episodes.title: Bart After Dark
episodes.overview: Bart gets a job at the Maison Derriere, an after-hours club of ill repute, much to Marge’s chagrin.

episodes.title: A Milhouse Divided
episodes.overview: Milhouse’s parents reveal they are divorcing. Homer becomes concerned that his own marriage is in trouble, but breathes easier when Marge agrees to renew their vows.

episodes.title: Lisa's Date with Density
episodes.overview: Against all her best instincts, Lisa has a puppy-love romance with bully Nelson Muntz. Meanwhile, Homer’s use of a telephone auto-dialer runs him afoul of the law.

episodes.title: Hurricane Neddy
episodes.overview: A hurricane blows through Springfield, destroying Ned Flanders’ home, but leaving the Simpsons unscathed. The pious Ned is so outraged by the unfairness of this that he winds up in an asylum.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Voyage of Homer
episodes.overview: Homer eats some ultra-hot chili, which immerses him in an out-of body experience reminiscent of Carlos Castaneda. In Homer’s vision, a talking coyote urges Homer to find his soul mate, which, after several false starts, he finally does.

episodes.title: The Springfield Files
episodes.overview: Homer sees an extraterrestrial, but no one in town believes him. He camps out with Bart, and they discover the surprising truth.

episodes.title: The Twisted World Of Marge Simpson
episodes.overview: Marge starts a pretzel franchise, but her attempts to make money are thwarted by a group of women known as the Springfield Investorettes. To help his wife, Homer recruits the assistance of mob boss Fat Tony.

episodes.title: Mountain of Madness
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns orders his employees to attend a survivalist company retreat. An avalanche traps Homer and Mr. Burns together in a small mountainside cabin.

episodes.title: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala(Annoyed Grunt)cious
episodes.overview: Marge’s hair begins to fall out from the stress of raising her children. A singing nanny, Shary Bobbins, mysteriously arrives to help.
