episodes.title: The Itchy & Scratchy & Poochie Show
episodes.overview: Attempting to update the appeal of Itchy & Scratchy cartoons, their writers add a new character. Their creation—a hip, surfboarding dog—is voiced by none other than Homer Simpson.

episodes.title: Homer's Phobia
episodes.overview: Homer begins to suspect that Bart is gay. When a visit to a steel mill to boost Bart's manliness backfires, Homer takes his son on a camping trip to "straighten him out."

episodes.title: Brother from Another Series
episodes.overview: Sideshow Bob returns to Springfield, this time with his evil brother, Cecil.

episodes.title: My Sister, My Sitter
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge go out and  put Lisa in charge of Bart, who nearly kills himself.

episodes.title: Homer vs. the Eighteenth Amendment
episodes.overview: A St. Patrick's Day riot leads Springfield to reinstate Prohibition. Homer becomes a notorious bootlegger known as the Beer Baron.

episodes.title: Grade School Confidential
episodes.overview: Bart’s principal and his teacher begin a secret romance. When Bart reveals it to the world, the two of them nearly lose their jobs.

episodes.title: The Canine Mutiny
episodes.overview: When Bart decides to get back Santa's Little Helper, he finds him living with a blind man.

episodes.title: The Old Man and the Lisa
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns loses all his money and must move into the decrepit Springfield Retirement Castle. Vowing to make back his fortune, Mr. Burns does it—with Lisa’s help—through recycling.

episodes.title: In Marge We Trust
episodes.overview: Marge attempts to assist Reverend Lovejoy and becomes more popular with his congregation than the Reverend is. Meanwhile, Homer is befuddled by his apparent likeness on a box of Japanese dish soap.

episodes.title: Homer's Enemy
episodes.overview: A new employee at the nuclear plant, Frank Grimes, is disgusted by Homer’s laziness and popularity. Grimes’ spite gets the better of him, but Homer is never aware of how much he was hated.

episodes.title: Simpsons' Spin-Off Showcase
episodes.overview: In this trilogy of Simpsons spin-offs that never made it, Chief Wiggum gets his own cop show, Grampa’s spirit inhabits the Love Tester at Moe’s, and the family gets a smarmy variety show—complete with a new Lisa.

episodes.title: The Secret War of Lisa Simpson
episodes.overview: A destructive prank gets Bart sent to a military school. Lisa joins as well, but is intimidated by a difficult physical test.

episodes.title: The City of New York vs. Homer Simpson
episodes.overview: The Simpsons go to New York City and, while there, Homer tries to retrieve his illegally parked car, and Marge and the kids see the sights, including a Broadway musical about the Betty Ford Center.

episodes.title: The Principal and the Pauper
episodes.overview: The people of Springfield are stunned to learn the man they believed was Seymour Skinner may not be who they thought. The man they knew as Skinner flees to Capital City until the Simpsons get him back.

episodes.title: Lisa the Simpson
episodes.overview: Lisa is horrified to learn that she might be losing her intelligence. Then she is relieved to learn that smarts in the Simpson family are passed down in a very surprising manner.

episodes.title: Lisa's Sax
episodes.overview: Lisa’s saxophone is destroyed and her family tells her how she came to get it. Then Homer must choose between an air conditioner and replacing Lisa’s instrument.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror VIII
episodes.overview: In “The Homega Man,” Homer must confront a post-apocalyptic Springfield. Bart becomes half-boy, half-fly in “Fly vs. Fly.” And we learn a shocking secret about Marge and her sisters in “Easy-Bake Coven.”

episodes.title: The Cartridge Family
episodes.overview: A soccer riot leads Homer to decide he needs a gun to protect his family. Marge makes him promise to get rid of it, but he defies her.

episodes.title: Bart Star
episodes.overview: Bart joins a junior-league football team. When Homer becomes coach, he replaces quarterback Nelson with the less talented Bart.

episodes.title: The Two Mrs. Nahasapeemapetilans
episodes.overview: Apu’s pre-arranged bride, Manjula, comes to Springfield. After trying to escape the match, Apu agrees to be married at the Simpsons’ home.

episodes.title: Lisa the Skeptic
episodes.overview: A skeleton is discovered in Springfield that seems to have come from an angel. Lisa is sure there is a rational explanation, but her beliefs are sorely tested.

episodes.title: Realty Bites
episodes.overview: Marge becomes a real estate agent, but is too honest for the job. Meanwhile, Homer buys a vintage convertible at a seized-property auction.

episodes.title: Miracle On Evergreen Terrace
episodes.overview: The town takes pity on the Simpsons, then are furious when they realize they have been fooled.

episodes.title: All Singing, All Dancing
episodes.overview: Homer's declared distaste for musicals prompts flashbacks to song-and-dance scenes from past episodes.

episodes.title: Bart Carny
episodes.overview: The Simpsons lose their home to a crafty carnival roadie and his son. The Simpsons must then outwit the carnies to get back their home.

episodes.title: The Joy of Sect
episodes.overview: Homer is lured into a cult that grows popular in Springfield. When Marge deprograms Homer, he gets the cult to disband.

episodes.title: Das Bus
episodes.overview: The Springfield Elementary school bus crashes, stranding the children on a deserted island. Meanwhile, Homer takes on Bill Gates and is crushed like a bug.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Krust
episodes.overview: Krusty realizes that his material is no longer young and hip. He attempts to reconnect with his audience, but in the end reverts to his old ways.

episodes.title: Dumbbell Indemnity
episodes.overview: To support a new girlfriend, Moe attempts insurance fraud. He lets Homer take the rap for his crime, and Homer plots revenge.

episodes.title: This Little Wiggy
episodes.overview: Bart befriends Ralph Wiggum and gets a master key to the town. Their explorations lead them to endanger the mayor’s life.

episodes.title: Simpson Tide
episodes.overview: Homer and his friends join the Naval Reserve. Homer seizes control of a nuclear sub and causes an international incident.

episodes.title: Trouble with Trillions
episodes.overview: Homer’s poorly-prepared tax return leads to an IRS audit. Homer helps entrap Mr. Burns and learns of the existence of a mysterious trillion-dollar bill.

episodes.title: Girly Edition
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa land jobs doing a children’s edition of the evening news. Meanwhile, Homer obtains a helper monkey, Mojo.

episodes.title: Trash of the Titans
episodes.overview: In the 200th episode of the series, Homer becomes the sanitation commissioner for Springfield. His ineptitude pollutes the town and leads to a drastic solution.

episodes.title: King of the Hill
episodes.overview: Homer attempts to get into shape by eating nutritional bars and working out. Overconfident in his newfound physique, Homer agrees to climb Springfield’s towering Murderhorn.

episodes.title: Lost Our Lisa
episodes.overview: Lisa gets lost in a strange part of town and Homer must get her back. Then she and Homer discover an age-old secret.

episodes.title: Natural Born Kissers
episodes.overview: Marge and Homer discover that public canoodling restores the passion in their marriage. They are forced to flee naked across town.

episodes.title: Lard of the Dance
episodes.overview: Lisa befriends a girl who tries to get the kids in Springfield Elementary to act older. Meanwhile, Homer attempts to start a business selling excess grease.

episodes.title: Wizard of Evergreen Terrace
episodes.overview: Homer is inspired to become an inventor by the example of Thomas Edison. Although he is not successful, a trip to the Edison Museum makes him feel that he is not a failure after all.

episodes.title: Bart, The Mother
episodes.overview: When Bart accidentally kills another bird, he feels so guilty that he raises her eggs as his own. But when the eggs hatch, a shock awaits him.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror IX
episodes.overview: Terrifying tales of Homer's hair transplant from an executed felon, Bart and Lisa sucked into an Itchy and Scratchy cartoon, and Marge's revelation that Maggie is the spawn of aliens who want their baby back.

episodes.title: When You Dish Upon a Star
episodes.overview: A parasailing mishap leads Homer to become the personal assistant for a celebrity couple. But when they don’t live up to his dreams, he turns upon them.

episodes.title: D'oh-In' in the Wind
episodes.overview: Homer learns his middle name, then befriends a pair of counter-culture entrepreneurs. Homer’s interference in their juice business leads them to ruin.

episodes.title: Lisa Gets an 'A'
episodes.overview: When she is unable to study properly for a test, Lisa buys an exam from Nelson Muntz. The tainted grade she gets qualifies Springfield Elementary for extra funding, so the school bands together to cover up her misdeed.

episodes.title: Homer Simpson in: "Kidney Trouble"
episodes.overview: After a long car trip to a recreated Western town, Grampa Simpson needs a new kidney. But before he will donate his kidney to his father, Homer flees and winds up on a ship of lost souls.

episodes.title: Mayored to the Mob
episodes.overview: Springfield hosts a science fiction convention which ends in a riot. Homer becomes the bodyguard to the Mayor, earning the enmity of mobster Fat Tony.

episodes.title: Viva Ned Flanders
episodes.overview: Homer and Ned enjoy a bender in Las Vegas. When they awake, they are shocked to find they have two extra wives.

episodes.title: Wild Barts Can't Be Broken
episodes.overview: When Homer and his friends trash the town after the baseball team wins a championship, Springfield’s children are blamed for the damage. The angry kids start a secret radio broadcast that reveals the adults’ secrets to the world.

episodes.title: Sunday, Cruddy Sunday
episodes.overview: Homer and his friends travel to the Super Bowl, then discover their tickets are fakes. Meanwhile Marge and Lisa attempt to pass the time with an arts and crafts project endorsed by Vincent Price.

episodes.title: Homer to the Max
episodes.overview: A popular TV character named Homer Simpson forces our Homer to change his name. He becomes popular with hip Springfielders, who lead him to run afoul of the law.

episodes.title: I'm with Cupid
episodes.overview: The wives of Springfield are jealous of the attention Apu lavishes on his wife Manjula. To win Marge back, Homer attempts to enlist the help of a skywriter, with painful consequences.

episodes.title: Marge Simpson In: "Screaming Yellow Honkers"
episodes.overview: Marge gets a huge new SUV, the Canyonero. She discovers the meaning of road rage, then must sacrifice her car to save her family.

episodes.title: Make Room for Lisa
episodes.overview: When Homer agrees to let a telephone company put a transmitter in Lisa’s room, she becomes Bart’s unwanted roommate. The stress leads Lisa to a sensory deprivation tank, where she learns to appreciate her father more.

episodes.title: Maximum Homerdrive
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a truck driver and discovers the other truckers’ shocking secret. Meanwhile, Marge and Lisa’s attempts to buy a doorbell introduce them to the heroic Señor Ding-Dong.

episodes.title: Simpsons Bible Stories
episodes.overview: Elementary students must slave away for Pharaoh Skinner, and Bart and Nelson are David and Goliath.

episodes.title: Mom and Pop Art
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a found artist, turning a failed barbecue pit into a pricey objet d’art. When his public turns on him, he floods the town to make a statement.

episodes.title: The Old Man and the 'C' Student
episodes.overview: As punishment for losing the Olympics for Springfield, Bart must help the city’s senior citizens. Meanwhile, Homer attempts to sell springs, one of which winds up embedded in Lenny’s eye.

episodes.title: Monty Can't Buy Me Love
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns realizes that he is not as beloved as a Richard Branson-type billionaire. To get the public back on his side, Burns, with Homer’s help, finds and captures the Loch Ness Monster.

episodes.title: They Saved Lisa's Brain
episodes.overview: Lisa bands together with Springfield’s other Mensa members to try to turn the town into a utopia. But they discover that genius doesn’t always know what it’s doing.

episodes.title: 30 Minutes Over Tokyo
episodes.overview: The Simpsons learn to cut corners, enabling them to afford a trip to Japan. In Japan, they lose their savings and must become contestants on a humiliating game show to earn their way back home.

episodes.title: Beyond Blunderdome
episodes.overview: Homer befriends Mel Gibson just as Mel is completing a remake of Mr. Smith Goes to Washington. Homer convinces him to make the film more violent, with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Brother's Little Helper
episodes.overview: When Bart commits an extremely destructive prank, he is given Focusyn, a pill to help him concentrate in school. At first the results are impressive, and then Bart starts believing in a conspiracy involving spy satellites and major league baseball.

episodes.title: Guess Who's Coming to Criticize Dinner?
episodes.overview: With Lisa’s help, Homer uses his vast knowledge of food to become the town’s leading restaurant critic. But when he gets petty and vindictive in his criticisms, all the other chefs in town try to kill him.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror X
episodes.overview: The Simpsons fear they have killed Ned Flanders, Lisa and Bart become "Stretch Dude and Clobber-Girl" superheroes, and Homer's horrific tales of Y2K.

episodes.title: E'i E'i (Annoyed Grunt)
episodes.overview: Homer takes his family to live on a farm where he discovers that by mixing tomatoes, tobacco, and radioactivity from the nuclear plant, he can create a dangerously delicious new substance.

episodes.title: Hello Gutter, Hello Fadder
episodes.overview: Homer bowls a perfect 300 game, then concludes that the greatest accomplishment of his life is behind him. He reconnects with the world by bonding with baby Maggie.

episodes.title: Eight Misbehavin'
episodes.overview: Due to overuse of fertility medication, Apu and wife Manjula give birth to octuplets. Desperate for money, Apu loans the babies to an unscrupulous carny promoter, then needs Homer’s help to get them back.

episodes.title: Take My Wife, Sleaze
episodes.overview: After winning a motorcycle at a dance contest, Homer becomes part of a motorcycle gang. But when he puts Marge’s photo in a biker magazine, a much tougher gang takes her, and he must win her back.

episodes.title: Grift of the Magi
episodes.overview: In this Christmas-themed episode, the students of Springfield Elementary are unwittingly used as a focus group to test new toys. The product of their labors, a cuddly doll named Funzo, is a lot more sinister than he appears.

episodes.title: Little Big Mom
episodes.overview: When Marge leaves the house to recuperate from a skiing injury, everything goes to hell — until Lisa convinces Homer and Bart they have leprosy.

episodes.title: Faith Off
episodes.overview: The town is convinced Bart has the powers of a faith healer, and mobster Fat Tony tries to turn the boy’s spiritual abilities in more sinister directions.

episodes.title: The Mansion Family
episodes.overview: Worried about his health, Mr. Burns visits the Mayo Clinic. He lets Homer house sit his mansion, which leads of course to an offshore knife fight and an attack by Chinese pirates.

episodes.title: Saddlesore Gallactica
episodes.overview: Homer and Bart befriend a horse at a county fair and turn it into a racehorse with an attitude.

episodes.title: Alone Again, Natura-Diddly
episodes.overview: Ned’s wife Maude is inadvertently killed by a T-shirt accident at an auto race. Homer and his family then try to help Ned cope.

episodes.title: Missionary: Impossible
episodes.overview: When Homer fails to give money he promised over the phone, he is forced by PBS stars to flee the country. He becomes a missionary on a small tropical island, where he introduces the natives to casino gambling.

episodes.title: Pygmoelion
episodes.overview: Plastic surgery gives Moe the bartender a handsome new face and a whole new life as a soap opera star.

episodes.title: Bart to the Future
episodes.overview: We see a possible future in which Bart is a grown-up slacker, living with Ralph Wiggum, while Lisa is no less than President of the United States.

episodes.title: Days of Wine and D'oh'ses
episodes.overview: After being embarrassed by a drunken video of himself, Barney vows to sober up. Newly clean, he gets work as a helicopter pilot.

episodes.title: Kill the Alligator and Run
episodes.overview: After a terrible bout with insomnia, Homer takes the family to Florida during spring break. There, they kill a beloved alligator and are sentenced to a chain gang.

episodes.title: Last Tap Dance in Springfield
episodes.overview: Lisa enters a tap dancing academy, where the teacher is a child star who never quite grew up. Meanwhile, Homer gets laser eye surgery.

episodes.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad Marge
episodes.overview: When Otto dumps his bride at the altar, she goes to live with the Simpsons — and the family comes to believe that Marge has lost her mind.

episodes.title: Behind the Laughter
episodes.overview: We learn the secrets of the Simpsons' rise, fall and ultimate reconciliation with the aid of Willie Nelson.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XI
episodes.overview: Homer's horoscope foretells his death; Lisa frees a dolphin from Marineland who banishes humans to the sea and takes over the land for dolphins; the Simpsons live out Grimm's fairy tales.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Springfields
episodes.overview: A new area code for half of Springfield leads to great divisions in the town. A wall goes up and only the music of The Who can bring it down.

episodes.title: Insane Clown Poppy
episodes.overview: Krusty the Clown discovers he has a daughter he never knew about. To win her love, he must get back a violin from mobster Fat Tony.

episodes.title: Lisa the Tree Hugger
episodes.overview: Lisa develops a crush on an older boy who is an environmental activist. To prevent a Redwood tree from being cut down, she starts to live in it, but through a series of misunderstandings, the forest is nearly turned into an amusement park.

episodes.title: Homer vs. Dignity
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns decides to make Homer do awful things for the sheer sport of it. But Homer draws the line when he is told to dress as Santa and ruin a Thanksgiving parade.

episodes.title: The Computer Wore Menace Shoes
episodes.overview: Homer becomes an internet blogger who anonymously tells the truth about the powerful and famous. It lands him on a secret island from which he must escape, in a satire of the cult '60s series, "The Prisoner."

episodes.title: The Great Money Caper
episodes.overview: After attending a magic show, Bart and Homer start conning Springfield residents out of their money. To teach them a lesson, Marge decides to grift the grifters.

episodes.title: Skinner's Sense of Snow
episodes.overview: Skinner insists the kids come to school during a blizzard, and they get snowed in. Homer and Flanders push through the snow to save them as the kids stage an uprising against Skinner.

episodes.title: HOMR
episodes.overview: In this Emmy-winning episode, Homer undergoes a medical treatment to make himself smarter. The new, more intelligent Homer becomes a better friend to Lisa, but the rest of his life worsens, and he decides to return to his normal, dimwitted self- but leaves behind a message of hope for Lisa.

episodes.title: Pokey Mom
episodes.overview: Marge befriends a convict who is an incredible artist. She invites him to live in the house, at the same time that Homer starts a chiropractic business and earns the enmity of others in the profession.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Comic Book Guy turns the store over to Bart and Milhouse and they discover a collection of videos.

episodes.title: Tennis the Menace
episodes.overview: Homer installs a tennis court with the money he was going to use to pay Grampa's funeral expenses. Bart and Marge become a successful doubles tennis team, which leads Homer to grow jealous of his own son.

episodes.title: Day of the Jackanapes
episodes.overview: Sideshow Bob returns and attempts to use Bart as a living bomb to kill Krusty the Clown. But when Krusty pays an emotional tribute to Bob on his show, Bob relents and must stop his boy-bomb.

episodes.title: New Kids On the Blecch
episodes.overview: Bart becomes a member of a boy band which grows incredibly popular. Then the boys are stunned to learn they are being used as pawns by the United States Navy.

episodes.title: Hungry, Hungry Homer
episodes.overview: After spending a day at an amusement park for children, Blockoland, Homer learns the local minor league baseball team is secretly planning to move to Albuquerque. To stop them Homer stages a hunger strike.

episodes.title: Bye, Bye, Nerdie
episodes.overview: Lisa tries to understand the hidden causes of bullyism and Homer sets up a childproofing business.

episodes.title: Simpson Safari
episodes.overview: The Simpsons journey to Africa after winning a contest on the back of an animal crackers box. They meet up with a monkey researcher who turns out to be secretly exploiting the monkeys to mine for diamonds.

episodes.title: Trilogy of Error
episodes.overview: Homer cuts off his thumb, Lisa builds a robot, and Bart and Milhouse get involved with fireworks.

episodes.title: I'm Goin' to Praiseland
episodes.overview: Marge and Homer attempt to get Ned past the death of his wife, but he is not ready to date.

episodes.title: Children of a Lesser Clod
episodes.overview: Homer sets up a day care center and earns the love of the town - but not his own son and daughter.

episodes.title: Simpsons Tall Tales
episodes.overview: In this three-part episode based on legends of Americana, Homer becomes Paul Bunyan, Lisa tries to save the world as Connie Appleseed, and Bart and Nelson become Tom Sawyer and Huck Finn - the rumor of whose deaths is not greatly exaggerated.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XII
episodes.overview: On Halloween, the Simpsons are menaced by a computer controlling an automated house; A gypsy curses Homer; Lisa and Bart find themselves in a Harry Potter-like adventure.

episodes.title: The Parent Rap
episodes.overview: When Bart is arrested for joyriding, a no-nonsense judge orders Homer to be shackled to his son 24/7.

episodes.title: Homer to the Moe
episodes.overview: When Moe returns to bartending school, Homer is put in charge of the bar. When Moe returns and attempts to “hippen up” his bar, a disgruntled Homer leads the barflies to his own makeshift watering hole.

episodes.title: A Hunka Hunka Burns in Love
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns finds a woman who turns out to be the girlfriend of the violent convict Snake.

episodes.title: The Blunder Years
episodes.overview: Homer recalls a dead body he saw years ago. Trying to resolve the mystery leads him on a trail back to Mr. Burns. Meanwhile, Marge gets a crush on the handsome man on a paper towel wrapper.

episodes.title: She of Little Faith
episodes.overview: When Homer and Bart’s attempts at model rocketry go awry, they enlist the help of nerds who soup up the rocket so much it destroys the church. To raise money, Reverend Lovejoy turns his finances over to Mr. Burns, who commercializes the church so much an offended Lisa leaves and becomes a Buddhist.

episodes.title: Brawl in the Family
episodes.overview: When the Simpsons are confined to their home, they begin to brawl violently and a social worker is called in. He solves their problems – only to have Marge get more upset than ever when the waitress Homer married in Vegas shows up at the door.

episodes.title: Sweets and Sour Marge
episodes.overview: Springfield enters the Duff Book of World Records as the world’s fattest town, leading Marge to attempt to place a ban on sugar.

episodes.title: Jaws Wired Shut
episodes.overview: Homer’s jaw is broken when he runs into a statue. Unable to speak, he becomes a better man, which surprisingly leads Marge to miss the old him.

episodes.title: Half-Decent Proposal
episodes.overview: Marge’s old beau, Artie Ziff, now a high-tech billionaire, offers Homer a million dollars if he will let Artie spend a weekend with Marge to try to convince her he made a mistake.

episodes.title: The Bart Wants What It Wants
episodes.overview: Bart starts dating Rainier Wolfcastle’s daughter, which Homer loves but Bart is not all that thrilled about. When Bart dumps her, and she starts dating Milhouse, Bart travels to Toronto to try to win her back.

episodes.title: The Lastest Gun in the West
episodes.overview: Fleeing a dog that hates him for no reason, Bart meets a faded Western star. With Marge’s help, Bart tries to get him off booze and start him on a better life.

episodes.title: The Old Man and the Key
episodes.overview: To impress a woman he fancies at the senior home, Grampa borrows Homer’s car, which he wrecks. He flees with Bart to Branson, Missouri, where the Simpsons encounter forgotten stars of yesteryear.

episodes.title: Tales from the Public Domain
episodes.overview: In this retelling of three classic tales from world history, Homer goes on the original Odyssey, Lisa meets a fiery fate as Joan of Arc, and Bart becomes the procrastinating prince of Denmark, Hamlet.

episodes.title: Blame It On Lisa
episodes.overview: A huge phone bill leads the Simpsons to discover that Lisa has been sponsoring an orphan in Brazil. Traveling to Rio, they encounter multicolored rats and rampaging monkeys in the episode that offended a nation.

episodes.title: Weekend at Burnsie's
episodes.overview: After being attacked by crows, Homer becomes addicted to medicinal marijuana prescribed by Dr. Hibbert. When Homer and his fellow stoners fail to vote in a referendum, the drug is recriminalized and Homer must go cold turkey.

episodes.title: Gump Roast
episodes.overview: The Springfield Friars Club roasts Homer, with emcee Krusty the Klown introducing friends, family, and their memories from past episodes.

episodes.title: I Am Furious (Yellow)
episodes.overview: Inspired by a highly successful cartoonist who visits his school, Bart creates an embarrassing Internet cartoon, “Angry Dad,” based on Homer. Meanwhile, Marvel Comics’ Stan Lee visits Comic Book Guy’s store – and won’t leave.

episodes.title: The Sweetest Apu
episodes.overview: Apu has an affair with a woman who delivers Squishees to his store. The Simpsons try to help him reconcile with his wife.

episodes.title: Little Girl in the Big Ten
episodes.overview: Lisa is befriended by college gymnasts who think she is one of them. Meanwhile, Bart is forced to live in a plastic bubble, isolated from the rest of the world.

episodes.title: The Frying Game
episodes.overview: Homer is ordered to do community service, where he befriends a needy elderly woman. When she is killed, Homer is blamed for her murder and sentenced to death.

episodes.title: Poppa's Got a Brand New Badge
episodes.overview: Losing all confidence in the local constabulary, Homer forms his own security company -- Springshield -- which subsequently replaces the police.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XIII
episodes.overview: In this three-part episode, Springfield is faced with a hungry horde of Homers, the town bans guns and finally, the people of Springfield become half-human/half-animal monstrosities.

episodes.title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
episodes.overview: When a hidden camera films Homer during a cab ride, he confesses his resentment that his family came between him and his rock ‘n’ roll dreams. To his surprise, Marge enrolls him in an adult rock ‘n’ roll fantasy camp run by Mick Jagger and Keith Richards. But, in Homer, the rock stars have met their match in violent decadence.

episodes.title: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade
episodes.overview: Bart is demoted to third grade while Lisa is advanced to the same class. They are both extremely unhappy with the situation, which is exacerbated when they are made “buddies” on a field trip to the state capital.

episodes.title: Large Marge
episodes.overview: Marge accidentally gets implants and decides to leave them in. Meanwhile, Krusty stages a rescue from an elephant, but the elephant gets out of control.

episodes.title: Helter Shelter
episodes.overview: When the Simpson home is tented for termites, they agree to go on a reality show in exchange for a place to live. The show forces the Simpsons to live as people did a hundred years ago, and the horror of it nearly splits the nuclear family apart.

episodes.title: The Great Louse Detective
episodes.overview: When someone attempts to murder Homer at a free weekend spa vacation, the police go to Sideshow Bob to help find the culprit. Working with the Simpsons, Bob discovers a surprising enemy from the family’s past — then must decide if he wishes to exact a revenge of his own.

episodes.title: Special Edna
episodes.overview: Bart tries to cheer up a dejected Mrs. Krabappel by entering her in a competition for Teacher of the Year. Surprisingly, she is nominated, and invited to the ceremony at EFCOT Center. Skinner follows, afraid that they may break up, and they reconcile with the help of Little Richard.

episodes.title: The Dad Who Knew Too Little
episodes.overview: When Homer gives Lisa an inappropriate birthday gift, he realizes how little he knows about his daughter. He hires a private detective to get information on her, but when Homer tries to stiff the P.I. for expenses, he and Lisa are framed for a crime they didn’t commit.

episodes.title: The Strong Arms of the Ma
episodes.overview: A terrifying mugging makes Marge afraid to leave the house. She starts to lift weights to regain her confidence, but an addiction to steroids proves even more harmful than her agoraphobia.

episodes.title: Pray Anything
episodes.overview: Homer discovers the power of prayer can answer any problem. When Homer is given the deed to the church, he becomes more sacrilegious until a cleansing rain makes matters right.

episodes.title: Barting Over
episodes.overview: Bart learns that he was once a child star whose earnings were squandered by Homer. Bart sues to become legally emancipated and Homer can only win him back with the help of skateboarding legend Tony Hawk.

episodes.title: I'm Spelling as Fast as I Can
episodes.overview: Lisa wins the state spelling finals, and is invited to the Spellympics, hosted by Renaissance man George Plimpton. Meanwhile, Homer is preoccupied with following a rib sandwich around participating Krusty Burger franchises.

episodes.title: A Star Is Born-Again
episodes.overview: When a left-handed movie star wanders into Ned Flanders’ store, a romance blossoms. They spend an incredible night together, then Ned informs her that if she wants more of his milk, she’ll have to buy the cow.

episodes.title: Mr. Spritz Goes to Washington
episodes.overview: The Simpsons convince Krusty to run for Congress, and he discovers the system is corrupt.

episodes.title: C.E. D'oh
episodes.overview: On a lonely Valentine’s Day evening, Homer attends a life-altering seminar, which teaches him to take a more aggressive course towards success. He becomes the head of the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant, only to discover how lonely the life of the man at the top truly is.

episodes.title: 'Scuse Me While I Miss the Sky
episodes.overview: A documentary filmmaker comes to Springfield Elementary and turns Bart and Lisa’s worlds topsy-turvy. Bart decides he needs to steal mobster Fat Tony’s hood ornament to prove that he’s “cool,” while Lisa tries to reduce the creeping threat of light pollution.

episodes.title: Three Gays of the Condo
episodes.overview: Homer discovers that Marge intended to break up with him while they were dating and is so upset he moves in with two gay roommates. Marge wins him back with the help of “Weird Al” Yankovic — and alcohol poisoning.

episodes.title: Dude, Where's My Ranch?
episodes.overview: Homer writes a song about Flanders that becomes so popular, the Simpsons leave town to avoid hearing it played. They make it to a dude ranch, where Lisa falls for an older boy, while Homer and Bart get involved in a range war with a herd of beavers.

episodes.title: Old Yeller-Belly
episodes.overview: When the cat saves Homer’s life during a fire, while the dog flees like a coward, Snowball II becomes a hero and the dog is chained outside the Simpsons’ house. There he is discovered by beer magnate H. K. Duff and turned into a corporate spokesmodel. The dog’s original owner learns of Santa’s Little Helper’s success and comes forward to reclaim him.

episodes.title: Brake My Wife, Please
episodes.overview: Distracted by his in-car appliances, Homer gets into an accident and has his license suspended. He discovers that walking makes him happier and healthier, until he is hit by a car — driven by Marge! Homer realizes how much hidden resentment his wife has towards him, and throws her a feast to regain her love.

episodes.title: The Bart of War
episodes.overview: Bart and Milhouse discover that Ned Flanders has a valuable Beatles collection — which they ruin. To provide them with more adult supervision, the boys are placed in separate youth groups.

episodes.title: Moe Baby Blues
episodes.overview: A traffic jam arising from a once-in-a-century flower emanation causes Maggie to nearly fall in the river, only to be saved inadvertently by Moe.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XIV
episodes.overview: In the fearsome fourteenth installment of this annual anthology, Homer becomes Death — and is ordered to kill Marge, Professor Frink’s father goes Zombie on the Nobel Prize ceremony. Also, Bart and Milhouse discover what it’s like to stop everything in the universe — except themselves.

episodes.title: My Mother the Carjacker
episodes.overview: Homer’s mother returns, and he finally achieves his dream of having her live in his house once more — only to lose her yet again.

episodes.title: The President Wore Pearls
episodes.overview: Lisa runs for Class President and is elected. When she discovers Skinner’s plans to reduce the budget, she leads a strike and is banished to a school for the gifted and troublesome.

episodes.title: The Regina Monologues
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns loses a thousand-dollar bill, and Bart earns enough charging people to see it that he can afford to take the Simpsons to England. While there, like all visitors, they encounter J.K. Rowling, Sir Ian McKellen and Prime Minister Tony Blair — and then Homer smashes into the Queen’s coach and is imprisoned in the Tower of London.

episodes.title: The Fat and the Furriest
episodes.overview: While at the dump, Homer is attacked by a bear.  So builds a suit designed to enable him to get revenge on the beast and conquer his fears.

episodes.title: Today I Am a Clown
episodes.overview: Krusty reveals that he has never been bar mitzvahed, and he agrees to do so as part of a network TV special, with the help of his father and Mr. T. Meanwhile, Homer replaces Krusty on the Sabbath with a talk show featuring him and his friends.

episodes.title: 'Tis the Fifteenth Season
episodes.overview: Homer spends all the family Christmas money on an astrolabe, then, inspired by Mr. McGrew’s version of “A Christmas Carol” he resolves to become the nicest man in town — to the irritation of the current nicest man, Ned Flanders.

episodes.title: Marge Versus Singles, Seniors, Childless Couples and Teens and Gays
episodes.overview: A children’s concert that Marge takes Maggie to erupts in an Altamont-style riot. The town’s reaction leads childless townspeople to protest how much of their taxes go to families, resulting in a climactic ballot measure to decide the direction of Springfield.

episodes.title: I, (Annoyed Grunt)-Bot
episodes.overview: In an effort to win his son’s love, Homer disguises himself as a robot to enter a violent battle-bot contest, and pays a huge physical price. Meanwhile, Lisa encounters a series of cats that have far less than nine lives.

episodes.title: Diatribe of a Mad Housewife
episodes.overview: Homer becomes an ambulance driver, while Marge writes a successful novel in which Homer is the thinly-disguised villain, and Flanders the hero.

episodes.title: Margical History Tour
episodes.overview: In this anthology of historical stories, Homer, as Henry VIII, cannot find a wife that will bear him a son, Lisa, as Sacagawea, is the brains behind Lenny Lewis and Carl Clark, and Bart is an Amadeus-inspired, boorishly-behaving Mozart.

episodes.title: Milhouse Doesn't Live Here Anymore
episodes.overview: Milhouse moves, and Bart is devastated. Meanwhile, Homer earns a small fortune as a beggar.

episodes.title: Smart & Smarter
episodes.overview: Lisa is stunned to discover that Maggie is the smartest one in the family. She runs away to live in the museum and her family must go through a giant human body to rescue her.

episodes.title: The Ziff Who Came to Dinner
episodes.overview: After taking the Flanders boys to an inappropriately scary movie, Homer finds Marge’s old flame Artie Ziff living in his attic. Artie tries to get Homer to take the fall for his failing high-tech company, but after a dalliance with Selma, he decides to do the right thing.

episodes.title: Co-Dependents' Day
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa are so disappointed by the latest Cosmic Wars movie that they travel to wine country to complain to the filmmaker. During a winery tour, Marge and Homer discover they share a love of drinking, which initially bonds them, but then becomes an alcoholic nightmare for both.

episodes.title: The Wandering Juvie
episodes.overview: Bart is sentenced to juvenile hall, where he is shackled to a very tough girl who despises — and has a crush on — him.

episodes.title: My Big Fat Geek Wedding
episodes.overview: Skinner finally agrees to marry Edna...but gets cold feet and blows the deal. She rebounds with Comic Book Guy, leading to a climactic battle at Comic-Con.

episodes.title: Catch 'em if You Can
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge decide they could really use a break from Bart and Lisa, leading the infuriated kids to follow them on an epic, cross-country chase.

episodes.title: Simple Simpson
episodes.overview: When Lisa is humiliated by a judge at a county fair, Homer gets revenge by anonymously pie-ing the villain. He becomes a superhero, until his identity is discovered and his powers abused by Mr. Burns.

episodes.title: The Way We Weren't
episodes.overview: In this flashback episode, we learn that Homer and Marge met as kids--an encounter that did not end well. The memory of this meeting threatens to derail their marriage in the present, until Marge learns how much Homer has always loved her.

episodes.title: Bart-Mangled Banner
episodes.overview: When Bart inadvertently moons the flag, he becomes a national focus of rage, and the Simpsons are exiled to a post 9-11 secret internment camp.

episodes.title: Fraudcast News
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns attempts to control all the media in Springfield, but cannot get his hands on Lisa’s little newspaper.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XV
episodes.overview: A knock to the noggin of Ned Flanders uncannily enables him to foretell the future — or does it? A knife-wielding killer roams Victorian London, and a fantastic journey through what can charitably be called the body of Mr. Burns.

episodes.title: All's Fair in Oven War
episodes.overview: Havoc erupts when the Simpsons remodel. Bart becomes enthralled by adult magazines — without the adult part, and remodels his lifestyle accordingly.

episodes.title: Sleeping with the Enemy
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa encounter two terrors of being a kid: Bart is tormented by a bully, whom Marge invites to live in their house, while Lisa fears she can never be thin enough.

episodes.title: She Used to Be My Girl
episodes.overview: Marge wonders what life would be like if she had a career in journalism instead of having a family.

episodes.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
episodes.overview: When Bart loses his last baby tooth, he suddenly feels old. He pours himself into a new business, making smart alecky T-shirts for a bizarre, Willy Wonka-ish manufacturer named Goose Gladwell.

episodes.title: Midnight Rx
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns throws a party for the power plant workers only to announce he is terminating their prescription drug program. Grampa and the seniors realize their only hope for affordable pills is smuggling drugs from Canada.

episodes.title: Mommie Beerest
episodes.overview: When the health inspector dies, Moe discovers his successor is not as friendly. To help Moe save his bar, Marge converts it into an English pub. But Homer begins to fear that Marge and Moe are having an “emotional affair.”

episodes.title: Homer and Ned's Hail Mary Pass
episodes.overview: Homer develops a business encouraging pro athletes to develop creative taunts, while Ned Flanders is so outraged by the indecency on television, he makes a movie of his own.

episodes.title: Pranksta Rap
episodes.overview: Bart is forbidden by his parents from attending a hip-hop concert, but does anyway. To cover up his lie, he pretends to be kidnapped — and Chief Wiggum takes this as an opportunity to do the best police work of his life.

episodes.title: There's Something About Marrying
episodes.overview: A television journalist finds Springfield to be the most unfriendly town ever. To restore its tourist business, Springfield legalizes gay marriage and Homer becomes an online minister.

episodes.title: On a Clear Day I Can't See My Sister
episodes.overview: When Bart embarrasses Lisa during a school field trip, she decides to get a restraining order against him. Bart at first is skeptical but is dismayed at how hard it can be to stay no closer than twenty feet from his sister.

episodes.title: Goo Goo Gai Pan
episodes.overview: Selma learns she is going through menopause, with the help of a video narrated by Robert Wagner. Realizing she’ll never have a baby of her own, she decides to go to China to adopt a child.

episodes.title: Mobile Homer
episodes.overview: Marge worries what they'd do for money when Homer is gone, so Homer purchases a mobile home.

episodes.title: The Seven-Beer Snitch
episodes.overview: A Frank Gehry-inspired concert house proves unpopular when the residents of Springfield discover they hate classical music. Mr. Burns buys the hall, and repurposes it as a prison. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers her cat has a double life.

episodes.title: Future-Drama
episodes.overview: In this look at the possible future of the Simpsons, Homer and Marge are separated and Bart is hit on by his fourth-grade teacher. And when Marge starts to date Krusty, Homer retreats to an underwater lair.

episodes.title: Don't Fear the Roofer
episodes.overview: Homer keeps putting off fixing a leaky roof. After being nagged by Marge, he is happy to meet a friendly contractor. As time passes, however, the rest of the family begins to doubt if this contractor even exists.

episodes.title: The Heartbroke Kid
episodes.overview: The school vending machine sells unhealthy snacks, so Bart becomes particularly addicted to sweets.

episodes.title: A Star Is Torn
episodes.overview: Lisa enters a “Li’l Star maker” contest, but is dismayed to discover how tough the competition really is. Homer becomes an overprotective stage parent, so abusive that Lisa fires him. Homer goes to work for Lisa’s main competitor, and Lisa wonders just where his heart truly lies.

episodes.title: Thank God It's Doomsday
episodes.overview:
A film about the rapture convinces Homer the end of the world is near. He draws the rest of Springfield into his beliefs, only to be terribly disappointed when the chosen hour comes
and nothing happens.

episodes.title: The Father, The Son And The Holy Guest Star
episodes.overview: Willie releases rats at the Medieval festival, Bart is blamed. He goes to Catholic school, where he befriends a cool priest named Father Sean and, to Marge’s dismay, considers converting.

episodes.title: Home Away from Homer
episodes.overview: Two sexy young women board at Flanders’ house and put their daily, titillating, life online, unbeknownst to Ned. When he learns the town was mocking him behind his back, Flanders decides to move.

episodes.title: The Bonfire of the Manatees
episodes.overview: When Homer loans the Simpson home to an adult filmmaker, Marge runs off and meets a handsome, athletic friend to the manatees.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Slept Too Little
episodes.overview: A cemetery is opened next to the Simpson house. Lisa grows too afraid to sleep in her own bed.

episodes.title: Milhouse of Sand and Fog
episodes.overview: Homer throws a chicken pox party, and Milhouse’s parents take the first steps towards reconciliation.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XVI
episodes.overview: In the 16th Halloween trilogy, a comatose Bart is replaced by a robot; Mr. Burns hunts citizens on his estate; and Springfield falls under a witch's spell that only Maggie can break. Terry Bradshaw and Dennis Rodman have cameos.

episodes.title: Marge's Son Poisoning
episodes.overview: Bart grows very close to Marge, then fears he has become a mama’s boy. Meanwhile, Homer gets one of his arms incredibly strong.

episodes.title: See Homer Run
episodes.overview: Homer's heroics during an emergency (caused by Bart) lead him to join the throng running for mayor when Quimby faces a recall.

episodes.title: The Last Of The Red Hat Mamas
episodes.overview: Marge joins a group of women, the “Cheery Red Tomatoes”, who have a sinister secret. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers a surprisingly enchanting side to Milhouse.

episodes.title: The Italian Bob
episodes.overview: When the Simpsons go to Italy to get a car for Burns, they discover that Sideshow Bob has become a beloved small-town mayor.

episodes.title: Simpsons Christmas Stories
episodes.overview: The Simpsons appear in three Christmas tales: the story of the birth of Jesus; a world war ii tale featuring Grampa, Mr. Burns, and Santa; and a musical featuring “the nutcracker suite.”

episodes.title: Homer's Paternity Coot
episodes.overview: Homer suspects that Grampa is not who he seems, and that his true father is a charming British adventurer.

episodes.title: We're On the Road to D'ohwhere
episodes.overview: Bart must go to a disciplinary camp in Oregon, but when he is discovered to be on the no-fly list, Homer must drive him cross-country.

episodes.title: My Fair Laddy
episodes.overview: Lisa determines to musically make a gentleman out of Groundskeeper Willie.

episodes.title: The Seemingly Neverending Story
episodes.overview: In this Emmy ®Award-winning episode, the Simpsons, when trapped in a cave, relate a complicated tale of love and money.

episodes.title: Bart Has Two Mommies
episodes.overview: A mother ape decides she loves Bart. Meanwhile, Marge grows attached to the Flanders boys.

episodes.title: Homer Simpson, This Is Your Wife
episodes.overview: In this episode penned by The Office’s Ricky Gervais, Homer trades wives with a henpecked British man who falls hard for Marge.

episodes.title: Million-Dollar Abie
episodes.overview: After a life-threatening crisis, Grampa becomes a bullfighter before he realizes the sport is too grisly for him.

episodes.title: Kiss Kiss, Bang Bangalore
episodes.overview: Springfield Nuclear outsources to India, and Homer goes mad when he attempts to run the plant.

episodes.title: The Wettest Stories Ever Told
episodes.overview: The Simpsons land at Plymouth Rock, Skinner fends off a mutiny, and a wave ruins a luxury cruise.

episodes.title: Girls Just Want to Have Sums
episodes.overview: Springfield Elementary is divided between the boys and the girls, and Lisa sneaks over to the other side in disguise to learn math.

episodes.title: Regarding Margie
episodes.overview: Marge loses her memory, and most tragically, forgets why she loves Homer.

episodes.title: The Monkey Suit
episodes.overview: Springfield Elementary stops the teaching of evolution.

episodes.title: Marge and Homer Turn a Couple Play
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge agree to become marriage counselors for a troubled local ballplayer and his sultry singing wife.

episodes.title: The Mook, the Chef, the Wife, and Her Homer
episodes.overview: Lisa meets Fat Tony’s son, Michael, who wants to be a chef. When Tony is wounded in an attempted hit, Homer takes over as head of the mob.

episodes.title: Jazzy and the Pussycats
episodes.overview: After Bart ruins a funeral, a therapist suggests the drums as a harmless outlet for Bart’s energies. Bart becomes a terrific drummer, and Lisa is jealous.

episodes.title: Please Homer, Don't Hammer 'Em
episodes.overview: Marge does carpentry work with Homer posing as her front, because the men in Springfield don’t believe women can do carpentry. Meanwhile Bart learns Principal Skinner is allergic to peanuts while Skinner discovers Bart is allergic to shrimp.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XVII
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a huge Blob, a Jewish guardian appears at school and the town falls victim to a hoax.

episodes.title: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt)
episodes.overview: Bart signs up to be a soldier when he turns 18. Homer gets him out of it, then signs up for duty himself.

episodes.title: Moe'N'a Lisa
episodes.overview: Lisa discovers that Moe has Bukowski-like poetic talent.   She takes him to Wordloaf, a literary conference in Vermont.

episodes.title: Ice Cream of Margie (with the Light Blue Hair)
episodes.overview: Homer begins driving an ice cream truck, and Marge, feeling a lack of accomplishment in her life, begins making sculptures from his popsicle sticks.

episodes.title: The Haw-Hawed Couple
episodes.overview: In this emmy-nominated episode, Bart is the only kid to show up at Nelson the bully’s birthday, and, uncomfortably for Bart, they become friends. Meanwhile Homer wants to spare Lisa the sad ending of a book they are reading together.

episodes.title: Kill Gil, Volumes I & II
episodes.overview: When Gil loses his job, he moves in with the Simpsons and doesn’t leave. Marge decides she needs to tell him off—which she does, inadvertently ruining his life.

episodes.title: The Wife Aquatic
episodes.overview: The Simpsons return to an island Marge loved as a child, which is now run down. Then Homer joins the crew of a doomed ship that gets caught in the perfect storm.

episodes.title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Three Times
episodes.overview: In this non-Halloween trilogy, Homer is the Count of Monte Cristo, Milhouse helps lead the nerds over the bullies, and we see the iconic origin of Bartman.

episodes.title: Little Big Girl
episodes.overview: Bart gets a drivers license, and he falls for an older girl from out of town. Meanwhile, Lisa lies about her heritage on a homework assignment.

episodes.title: Springfield Up
episodes.overview: In this satire of the acclaimed “Up” series of documentaries, we see the residents of Springfield at key points in their lives.

episodes.title: Yokel Chords
episodes.overview: Lisa tutors the Spuckler children, while Bart scares the entire school with a phony tale of terror.

episodes.title: Rome-Old and Juli-Eh
episodes.overview: As predicted in Gump Roast, Grampa marries Selma, while Bart and Lisa wage war with a package delivery service.

episodes.title: Homerazzi
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a paparazzo, earning the enmity of Springfield’s celebrities. Featuring the debut of the classic “Evolution” couch gag.

episodes.title: Marge Gamer
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a soccer referee, while Marge aggravates Bart by joining his violent online game.

episodes.title: The Boys of Bummer
episodes.overview: Bart loses a key game for his little league team, and becomes an outcast in the town.

episodes.title: Crook and Ladder
episodes.overview: Homer becomes addicted to sleep medication, then joins with Apu, Moe and Principal Skinner to become volunteer firemen.

episodes.title: Stop! Or My Dog Will Shoot!
episodes.overview: Homer gets lost in a cornfield maze, then is saved by Santa’s Little Helper, who becomes a police dog, and then is jaded by crime.

episodes.title: 24 Minutes
episodes.overview: In this complex satire of 24, Marge has to rush to make the bake sale, Homer must rid himself on unsavory yogurt and the bullies try to stink bomb the school.

episodes.title: You Kent Always Say What You Want
episodes.overview: In the 400th episode of the Simpsons, Kent Brockman loses his job for uttering a profanity on air.

episodes.title: He Loves to Fly and He D'oh's
episodes.overview: Homer is thrilled to ride on Mr. Burns' private plane to Chicago. It inspires him to get a life coach and apply for a new job.

episodes.title: The Homer of Seville
episodes.overview: Homer discovers when lying flat on his back he has a beautiful singing voice. He becomes targeted for death by a mysterious groupie.

episodes.title: Midnight Towboy
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a tow truck driver to the consternation of others. Meanwhile Marge tries raising Maggie with a controversial child-rearing approach.

episodes.title: I Don't Wanna Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
episodes.overview: Marge goes to the bank and is enmeshed in a robbery. She befriends the robber then has second thoughts.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XVIII
episodes.overview: Bart befriends an alien only to discover he has evil intents; Marge and Homer, unbeknownst to the others, are professional assassins; Flanders opens a Christian alternative to Halloween haunted houses.

episodes.title: Little Orphan Millie
episodes.overview: Milhouse's parents disappear on a cruise. Meanwhile Homer gets in trouble with Marge because he can't remember the color of her eyes.

episodes.title: Husbands and Knives
episodes.overview: A new friendlier comic book store opens in Springfield and Comic Book Guy is aghast. Marge becomes a successful businesswoman and Homer is afraid he will dump her.

episodes.title: Funeral for a Fiend
episodes.overview: Sideshow Bob opens a restaurant with an assumed name and lures in the Simpsons, then seemingly dies.

episodes.title: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
episodes.overview: Homer cannot remember last night when something awful happened to Marge and his family disappeared.

episodes.title: E Pluribus Wiggum
episodes.overview: Springfield gets the first in the nation primary and Ralph runs for president, promising to make America great again.

episodes.title: That '90s Show
episodes.overview: In this flashback to the era when Homer and Marge were together before Bart was born, Marge is attracted to her professor and Homer sings in a grunge band, Sadgasm.

episodes.title: Love, Springfieldian Style
episodes.overview: In this Valentine's-themed show, the Simpsons explore the twisted romantic lives of Bonnie and Clyde, Sid and Nancy and Lady and the Tramp.

episodes.title: The Debarted
episodes.overview: Bart befriends a cool older kid only to discover he is a plant working for Principal Skinner.

episodes.title: Dial "N" for Nerder
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa are afraid they have killed Martin Prince. Meanwhile Marge employs a reality TV show to discover if Homer is cheating on his diet.

episodes.title: Smoke On the Daughter
episodes.overview: Lisa takes ballet and becomes addicted to second-hand smoke. Meanwhile Homer and Bart make jerky.

episodes.title: Papa Don't Leech
episodes.overview: Homer's former protege Lurleen Lumpkin returns with her no-good hamboning father in tow.

episodes.title: Apocalypse Cow
episodes.overview: With the help of Cletus' daughter Mary, Bart raises a prize calf only to be terrified when it is sold for slaughter.

episodes.title: Any Given Sundance
episodes.overview: Lisa enters a film in the Sundance festival under the Chalmskin production banner. The documentary proves embarrassing to her family.

episodes.title: Mona Leaves-a
episodes.overview: Homer's mother returns to him for good--then dies. To cope with his grief he tries to honor her unusual last wishes.

episodes.title: All About Lisa
episodes.overview: The season ends with Mr. Burns losing a penny, just as it began with him finding one. We see the rise of Lisa as Krusty's assistant, narrated by Mel.

episodes.title: Sex, Pies, and Idiot Scrapes
episodes.overview: Homer is sent to jail after a brawl at the St. Patrick's Day parade. When he goes to get his bail bond, Homer meets Lucky Jim and "Wolf the Bounty Hunter" and decides to try his own hand at the lucrative but deadly profession. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to her, Marge begins working at an erotic bakery.

episodes.title: Lost Verizon
episodes.overview: Bart pretends to be a celebrity after finding Denis Leary's phone while working at a country club.

episodes.title: Double, Double, Boy in Trouble
episodes.overview: When Lenny wins the lottery and invites the Simpsons to a celebratory party, Bart meets his doppelganger, Simon Woosterfield, who is a member of the richest family in Springfield. Simon and Bart decide to switch places, and Bart arrives at the lavish Woosterfield mansion. As Simon adjusts to the life over at the Simpson household, Bart notices his new siblings acting strangely toward him.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XIX
episodes.overview: Transformer-like robots duke it out, Homer kills off celebrities, and Lisa goes to a pumpkin patch.

episodes.title: Dangerous Curves
episodes.overview: A family vacation at a cabin in the woods brings back memories: Homer and Marge reminisce about their courtship, while Bart and Lisa recall their early childhood.

episodes.title: Homer and Lisa Exchange Cross Words
episodes.overview: Lisa discovers her talent for doing crossword puzzles and becomes an expert cruciverbalist, and she soon enters a citywide crossword puzzle tournament. Homer, short on cash after abandoning his professional break-up artist business, goes to cheer Lisa on and discovers a crossword puzzle betting ring. In the ultimate betrayal, Homer profits from betting against Lisa in the championship match.

episodes.title: MyPods and Boomsticks
episodes.overview: The Simpsons take a trip to the mall where Bart interrupts Steve Mobbs with his own voiceover, causing pandemonium. On his way home, Bart narrowly escapes punishment and befriends a Muslim boy named Bashir. Homer becomes suspicious and invites Bashir and his parents over for dinner, where he offends them. Homer goes to their home to apologize, but instead he snoops around their house.

episodes.title: The Burns and the Bees
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns wins a basketball team in poker and decides to win over the basketball fans of Springfield by building a sports arena. Unfortunately, Springfield's last bee colony is located on the proposed site and Lisa is spearheading a movement to protect them. Homer attempts to help the bee population by mating the bees with Africanized bees, creating a swarm that disrupts Burns' opening night.

episodes.title: Lisa the Drama Queen
episodes.overview: Lisa befriends a highly creative girl and they develop a fantasy world, but Marge becomes concerned. She forbids Lisa to see her friend, but Lisa defies Marge and runs away.

episodes.title: Take My Life, Please
episodes.overview: Homer learns that he was elected class president, but the election was stolen from him by his high school principal. At Luigi's Italian restaurant, Homer meets an old Italian man who can show him visions of what his future as class president would have been like. Homer sees a life he could have led filled with riches and success, and his family must find a way for him to be happy the way he is.

episodes.title: How the Test Was Won
episodes.overview: When Springfield Elementary must take the Vice-President's Assessment Test, the superintendent arranges to have all the poor students taken out of school for the day. Principal Skinner is tricked into accompanying the delinquents, and they must work together to find their way back from the heart of Capital City.

episodes.title: No Loan Again, Naturally
episodes.overview: The Simpsons spend too much money on an annual Mardi Gras bash, and when the rate on their home equity loan goes up they lose their home. Ned Flanders takes pity on the family and buys their home to rent back to them. When they ask Ned, their new landlord, for excessive repairs, he evicts them. But when a new couple tries to rent the home, a melancholy Ned realizes he misses the Simpsons too much.

episodes.title: Gone Maggie Gone
episodes.overview: A rare solar eclipse temporarily blinds Marge. Without her in charge, rats take over the kitchen, and when Homer gets poison to kill them, he must briefly set Maggie down outside a convent, where the nuns take her in. Meanwhile, Lisa uncovers a plot to bring everlasting peace to Springfield, involving a mystical gem, the founding fathers, and Principal Skinner's mother's minivan.

episodes.title: In the Name of the Grandfather
episodes.overview: The Simpsons let Grampa down and agree to do one thing he's always wanted. They fly to Ireland to visit a pub Grampa loved as a young man, and wind up buying it, only to find that the Irish no longer want to hang out in pubs. The Simpsons bring Moe over to give them advice, and he suggests they allow smoking in the pub, which runs them afoul of Irish law.

episodes.title: Wedding for Disaster
episodes.overview: After learning that their marriage is in-valid, Homer asks Marge to renew their vows, but he mysteriously disappears before the wedding.

episodes.title: Eeny Teeny Maya, Moe
episodes.overview: Moe meets a woman online who turns out to be three feet tall. He falls in love but finds that his own shortcomings are too great for the relationship to survive. Meanwhile, Homer finds a new playground for Maggie that seems idyllic--until she runs into some baby bullies. Marge suspects that something is wrong, and, with misgivings, decides to electronically pry into Homer's daddy-daughter time.

episodes.title: The Good, the Sad and the Drugly
episodes.overview: When a jealous Milhouse learns of Bart's romance, he threatens to reveal Bart's past.

episodes.title: Father Knows Worst
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a hovering parent when he learns Bart and Lisa are struggling at school.

episodes.title: Waverly Hills 9-0-2-1-D'oh
episodes.overview: A visit to Springfield Elementary convinces Marge the kids need a better school. The Simpsons rent a tiny apartment in an upscale neighborhood to enroll in a better school district. Marge and Homer discover that the intimacy of the apartment rekindles the spark in their marriage, but Lisa discovers that the other students in her new school are not as welcoming as she would have hoped.

episodes.title: Four Great Women and a Manicure
episodes.overview: Marge and Lisa get mani-pedis. While there, they swap stories about powerful women through history.

episodes.title: Coming to Homerica
episodes.overview: When Krustyburger serves tainted barley, the barley suppliers in Ogdenville are forced out of work. They emigrate to Springfield, where they prove to be hardworking and polite. But as they become more and more a part of Springfield's daily life, Homer and his friends form a border brigade to keep them out, culminating in the building of a wall between the two cities.

episodes.title: Homer the Whopper
episodes.overview: Comic Book guy creates a comic book and casts Homer in the lead. Homer gets fit with the help of a trainer, but when the trainer leaves, he soon regains the weight he lost.

episodes.title: Bart Gets a 'Z'
episodes.overview: When Bart tries to loosen up his teacher by spiking her coffee, he gets her so drunk she loses her job. He tries to make it up to her by helping her open a muffin store, but she discovers the truth. Meanwhile, her replacement turns out to be a cool young teacher who can work the internet.

episodes.title: The Great Wife Hope
episodes.overview: The Ultimate Punch, Kick and Choke Championship comes to town. Marge starts a campaign to ban the "sport" and the event's founder agrees to shut it down if she fights him and wins.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XX
episodes.overview: In this annual terror-themed thrilled, Dracula and the Wolfman walk the streets of Springfield, Bart and Lisa cause carnage in the school in a Hitchcock-themed segment, Krusty's new hamburger made from mad cows turns the town into zombies, and Moe falls for Marge in a creepy broadway musical--but can only win her over by serving her beer mixed with Homer's blood.

episodes.title: The Devil Wears Nada
episodes.overview: Marge poses for a calendar to raise money for charity and the photographer eases her inhibitions with wine, resulting in some provocative photos that make her the talk of the town.

episodes.title: Pranks and Greens
episodes.overview: Bart learns of a prankster from Springfield's past and becomes fast friends with the joker.

episodes.title: Rednecks & Broomsticks
episodes.overview: Lisa joins a group of teenage wiccans, while Homer becomes a moonshine aficionado. When half the town goes blind from the moonshine, they blame the witches, and try them according to ancient Springfield laws.

episodes.title: Oh Brother, Where Bart Thou?
episodes.overview: Bart realizes that Lisa has a bond with Maggie that he will never have, because he has no brother.  After a dream about famous brothers from Wright to Mario, Bart tries to adopt one, but finds having a brother can bring as much pain as pleasure.

episodes.title: Thursdays with Abie
episodes.overview: Grampa becomes famous when a human-interest columnist publishes his anecdote about serving on a battleship in World War II that was struck by a torpedo.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time in Springfield
episodes.overview: Krusty gets a Disney-style princess sidekick. Mr. Burns eliminates donuts from the break room.

episodes.title: Million Dollar Maybe
episodes.overview: Homer wins a million dollars in the lottery, but bought the ticket while he was supposed to be helping his wife, so he can't spend the money without her getting furious at him.  When Bart learns of Homer's secret, he threatens to tell Marge unless Homer does whatever he wants.

episodes.title: Million Dollar Maybe
episodes.overview: Homer wins a million dollars in the lottery, but bought the ticket while he was supposed to be helping his wife, so he can't spend the money without her getting furious at him.  When Bart learns of Homer's secret, he threatens to tell Marge unless Homer does whatever he wants.

episodes.title: Boy Meets Curl
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge take up curling, but Marge's superior skills cause a rift between them.

episodes.title: The Color Yellow
episodes.overview: While researching her family tree, Lisa discovers the diary of an ancestor that reveals the Simpson family was in the underground railroad before the Civil War. After further investigation she is shocked to learn that her ancestors were not what they seem.

episodes.title: Postcards from the Wedge
episodes.overview: When Bart realizes he can exploit Marge and Homer's differences, it nearly breaks their marriage apart. And when he discovers an abandoned subway underneath Springfield, it nearly breaks the town apart.

episodes.title: Stealing First Base
episodes.overview: Bart meets a girl with whom he is alternately infatuated and infuriated. His furtive kiss creates a ban on public displays of affection in the school. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers she has a secret supporter, who turns out to be surprisingly successful.

episodes.title: The Greatest Story Ever D'ohed
episodes.overview: Ned Flanders invites the Simpsons on a trip to the Holy Land. Homer believe he is the messiah.

episodes.title: American History X-cellent
episodes.overview: An office party at Mr. Burns' mansion turns into a drunken riot--landing Burns in jail. In prison, a deeply religious convict takes Burns under his wing and tries to make a good man of him.

episodes.title: Chief of Hearts
episodes.overview: Homer befriends Chief Wiggum, but when Wiggum saves his life, the friendship gets too close for Homer's comfort. Meanwhile, Bart gets addicted to a Japanese card/robot/adventure game.

episodes.title: The Squirt & the Whale
episodes.overview: Homer attempts to power the house with a wind turbine. After a freak windstorm knocks out the turbine, a whale washes up on shore, and the town attempts to save it.

episodes.title: To Surveil with Love
episodes.overview: When Homer's unattended bag causes a bomb scare at Springfield Union station, the town introduces draconian security measures. Surveillance cameras are installed all over town, and the only unsupervised spot is in the Simpsons' back yard. Meanwhile, Lisa encounters discrimination because she is a blonde.

episodes.title: Moe Letter Blues
episodes.overview: Moe writes a letter to Homer, Apu and Rev. Lovejoy and threatens to run off with their wives. In flashbacks, the three guys remember intimate moments between Moe and their ladies.

episodes.title: The Bob Next Door
episodes.overview: The Simpsons get a new next door-neighbor, who, despite all appearances, Bart believes to be SIDESHOW BOB! He uncovers the shocking truth and a desolate spot where five states meet.

episodes.title: Elementary School Musical
episodes.overview: Lisa gets a dream week at arts camp where her counselors are Flight of the Conchords, then finds her return to the real world is more than a little disheartening. Meanwhile, Krusty discovers winning the Nobel Peace prize is not what it seems, and he must fight for his freedom in the World Court.

episodes.title: Loan-a-Lisa
episodes.overview: Lisa invests in Nelson's new business, which becomes an instant success, but cautions him against dropping out of school as a result.

episodes.title: MoneyBart
episodes.overview: Lisa coaches Bart's little league team to beef up her extracurricular-activities résumé, but her academic approach to the game takes some of the fun out of it for Bart.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXI
episodes.overview: In this annual terror-filled trilogy, the old board games in the Simpson attic come to life and wreak havoc in Springfield, Marge and Homer's romantic cruise is interrupted by a mysterious, handsome stranger who Homer believes is trying to kill them, and Lisa falls in love with a tweenage vampire, only to run afoul of his old-school vampire father.

episodes.title: Lisa Simpson, This Isn't Your Life
episodes.overview: Marge was once an excellent student. Bart accidentally beats up Nelson and becomes the school bully.

episodes.title: The Fool Monty
episodes.overview: During a "housecat flu" scare, Mr. Burns is startled to discover that everyone in town hates him. He tries to take his own life, but fails, losing his memory in the process. The townspeople use the opportunity to seek revenge on him for the harm he has inflicted upon them through the years.

episodes.title: How Munched Is That Birdie in the Window?
episodes.overview: A storm blows a pigeon through the Simpsons' window, and Bart makes it his pet. He nurses it back to health, and when he is approached by Moe to turn it into a racing pigeon he has to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: The Fight Before Christmas
episodes.overview: Bart heads to a surprisingly downsized North Pole to get a toy he wants; Marge attempts to kill Hitler at Christmas, Martha Stewart takes over the Simpson family holiday, and Katy Perry performs with the Simpsons--in puppet form for the first time ever.

episodes.title: Donnie Fatso
episodes.overview: When Homer runs afoul of tough new ordinances that take effect January 1, he goes undercover with the mob to shorten his sentence. He finds that the Springfield Mafia is much more welcoming and lovable than he ever would have suspected.

episodes.title: Moms I'd Like to Forget
episodes.overview: A war between the fourth and fifth graders leads Bart to discover an unusual scar on his wrist. Learning the secret of its origin unlocks a secret from Marge's past. Bart's journey to the truth takes him to Comic Book Guy, and a Fourth of July long ago gone horribly wrong.

episodes.title: Flaming Moe
episodes.overview: To impress Mr. Burns, Smithers helps Moe turn his tavern into a gay bar that caters to men who are less than perfect. Meanwhile, a substitute music teacher becomes the passion of Principal Skinner's life. Moe enjoys his new clientele so much he considers running for city council. Meanwhile, Principal Skinner must choose between his career and a free-spirited substitute music teacher.

episodes.title: Homer the Father
episodes.overview: Homer becomes obsessed with a cheesy '80s sitcom and tries to apply its outdated lessons to his own relationship with Bart.  A disgruntled Bart is driven straight into the arms of Chinese nuclear spies.

episodes.title: The Blue and the Gray
episodes.overview: When Marge decides to "go gray" with her hair, she is startled by the reaction of her friends and family. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a "wing man", first to Moe, then to every single guy in town.

episodes.title: Angry Dad: The Movie
episodes.overview: When the “Angry Dad” character is turned into an award-winning animated short film, Homer hogs the spotlight much to Bart’s dismay.

episodes.title: The Scorpion's Tale
episodes.overview: When Lisa discovers a wildflower that turns scorpions into blissful creatures, Homer secretly spikes Grampa’s coffee with juice from the plant, turning him into a docile old man.

episodes.title: A Midsummer's Nice Dreams
episodes.overview: When Cheech and Chong split up during a performance in Springfield, Homer gets a chance to perform stoner comedy--but finds it is not the high life he imagines. Meanwhile, Marge attempts to cure the crazy Cat Lady of her hoarding.

episodes.title: Love Is a Many Strangled Thing
episodes.overview: When Homer reveals in therapy that he has strangled Bart for years, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar is brought in to effectuate a cure. Homer becomes so intimidated by his son that Bart starts to run wild, terrorizing his father and the school.

episodes.title: The Great Simpsina
episodes.overview: Lisa becomes an apprentice to a magician and ends up embroiled in a showdown of the craft's elite.

episodes.title: The Real Housewives of Fat Tony
episodes.overview: Selma's behavior at the DMV leads to an unexpected romance with Fat Tony, and a trip to see Tony's relatives on the Jersey shore. Meanwhile, Lisa discovers Bart has truffle-sniffing abilities previously seen only in pigs--abilities which lead him to be exploited by his sister.

episodes.title: Homer Scissorhands
episodes.overview: Homer discovers his natural gift for hairstyling. But he finds that the women in Springfield tell him more about their men than he wants to know. Meanwhile, Milhouse publicly declares his love for Lisa, is rejected, then is stunned to discover someone who likes him as much as he likes her. An equally stunned Lisa becomes obsessed with finding out just what Milhouse's new girlfriend sees in him.

episodes.title: 500 Keys
episodes.overview: The family discovers 500 old keys in a drawer and tries to find out what they do. Marge sets a farting novelty toy loose on the town, Homer achieves a lifelong dream as he pilots the Duff blimp, Bart is dismayed to find that every prank he tries to pull turns into a good deed, and Lisa uncovers a shocking mystery in the basement of the school.

episodes.title: The Ned-Liest Catch
episodes.overview: Ned Flanders saves Edna Krabappel's life and they begin dating. To Ned's surprise, he learns that Edna has been with many of Springfield's men, including Homer and Aerosmith drummer Joey Kramer.

episodes.title: The Falcon and the D'ohman
episodes.overview: There is a new Springfield nuclear employee with a mysterious past--that Homer tries to uncover. Homer discovers his new friend is a former undercover agent--whose enemies realize they can flush out by kidnapping Homer. Also, Nedna, the result!

episodes.title: Bart Stops to Smell the Roosevelts
episodes.overview: Superintendent Chalmers takes a special interest in Bart, and discovers he can reach him through study of our 26th president. Chalmers is fired after taking Bart and his friends on an unauthorized camping trip and Bart and his rough riders saddle up to win the superintendent's job back.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXII
episodes.overview: A paralyzed Homer can only communicate by passing gas--but discovers it makes him a better man, a vengeful Flanders becomes a killer from the Lord--only to discover that the "voice from above" is actually coming from somewhere else, and Bart takes the form of a powerful alien being on an exotic but deadly garden planet.

episodes.title: Replaceable You
episodes.overview: Bart's science fair project, a realistic little robot seal, unexpectedly brings joy to Springfield's elderly. Meanwhile, a new coworker disrupts Homer's peaceful life at the plant. He is in danger of losing all, until Ned Flanders reveals his foe's secret weakness.

episodes.title: The Food Wife
episodes.overview: When she gets lost in an unfamiliar ethnic neighborhood, Marge discovers the joy of exotic food. It becomes a new activity for her and the kids, until Homer gets jealous and Marge inadvertently sends him to a crackhouse.

episodes.title: The Book Job
episodes.overview: Homer and Bart try to defraud a publishing house and settle on Lisa as the front for the operation.

episodes.title: The Man in the Blue Flannel Pants
episodes.overview: After Homer hosts a party to promote Krusty's new liquor, Mr. Burns makes him an account exec.

episodes.title: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution
episodes.overview: The Simpsons encounter a venerable TV agent and are stunned to discover she gave Krusty her start. Now they need her to help him again--but her bitterness at their breakup stands in the way.

episodes.title: Holidays of Future Passed
episodes.overview: At a Simpson Christmas thirty years in the future Bart and Lisa discover the perils of parenthood in a post-apocalyptic world. Meanwhile Maggie creates a miracle of her own.

episodes.title: Politically Inept, with Homer Simpson
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a blowhard TV pundit and attempts to select our next president. Ted Nugent teaches him the true meaning of the Constitution.

episodes.title: The D'oh-cial Network
episodes.overview: When Lisa can't make friends in person she tries to do so with an online network. The effect on Springfield is so ruinous she is put on trial.

episodes.title: Moe Goes from Rags to Riches
episodes.overview: The story of western civilization is recounted by Moe's bar rag. More significantly, Milhouse decides he's had just about enough of being Bart's patsy.

episodes.title: The Daughter Also Rises
episodes.overview: Lisa meets a boy who seems to be the reincarnation of Ernest Hemingway, but turns out to be less than he appears. Meanwhile, Bart and Milhouse debunk myths at school, to the dismay of their fellow students.

episodes.title: At Long Last Leave
episodes.overview: Fed up with the family’s negative impact on the city, townspeople banish the Simpsons from Springfield.

episodes.title: Exit Through the Kwik-E-Mart
