episodes.overview: When Homer punishes Bart by sticking him in a rabbit cage, Bart retaliates by making Homer's face an iconic graffiti image throughout Springfield.

episodes.title: How I Wet Your Mother
episodes.overview: Following a traumatic incident, Homer's bed-wetting problem worsens, and his family decide to infiltrate his dreams to get to its subconscious source. And in Homer's dreams is where his late mother resides.

episodes.title: Them, Robot
episodes.overview: To avoid litigation from radiation exposure, Mr. Burns replaces every worker in the nuclear plant except Homer with a robot. Homer experiences a savage isolation when he tries unsuccessfully to befriend his non-human coworkers.

episodes.title: Beware My Cheating Bart
episodes.overview: Homer gets wrapped up in a sci-fi mystery series that finished years ago, only to have Marge blow the shocking ending for him.

episodes.title: A Totally Fun Thing That Bart Will Never Do Again
episodes.overview: Bart convinces his parents to take a cruise that he wishes would never end.

episodes.title: The Spy Who Learned Me
episodes.overview: Homer learns to woo Marge with the help of an imaginary spy. Meanwhile Bart attempts to neutralize Nelson the bully by fattening him up.

episodes.title: Ned 'n Edna's Blend Agenda
episodes.overview: Complications ensue when Flanders and Krabappel admit they’re secretly married.

episodes.title: Lisa Goes Gaga
episodes.overview: Lisa has an internet defender who is not what he seems. Then Lady Gaga arrives and makes everyone in town feel like a little monster--except Lisa.

episodes.title: Moonshine River
episodes.overview: Bart realizes that the girls he's liked all dump him within a week. To prove he can be loved, he journeys to New York and seeks out a former flame.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXIII
episodes.overview: A search for the Higgs Boson creates a black hole that sucks in Springfield until it is stopped by a most unlikely hero. Found footage reveals a demonic deal from the Simpsons' past comes back to terrorize them in the present and Bart learns what life would have been like if Homer hadn't taken Marge to the prom. Also, the end of the world as foretold by the ancient Mayans.

episodes.title: Adventures in Baby-Getting
episodes.overview: A sinkhole destroys Marge's car and when she gets a more compact replacement she realizes she wants a baby. Meanwhile, Lisa mysteriously vanishes every day after school and the only clue is "boxing wizards".

episodes.title: Gone Abie Gone
episodes.overview: Grampa disappears, and while trying to find him they learn he had a second wife.

episodes.title: Penny-Wiseguys
episodes.overview: Fat Tony names his accountant head of the mob, and then asks him to kill members of the gang. Meanwhile, vegetarian Lisa starts eating bugs, until she realizes they are a gateway to shrimp.

episodes.title: A Tree Grows in Springfield
episodes.overview: A depressed Homer wins a myPad and the tablet changes his life--until it breaks. Then he receives new hope from a most unlikely source.

episodes.title: The Day the Earth Stood Cool
episodes.overview: Portland comes to Springfield in the form of Homer's new hipster neighbors. While Homer loves the designer donuts, Marge is none too crazy about the breast-feeding mafia.

episodes.title: To Cur with Love
episodes.overview: While playing a civilization-building Internet game, Homer loses the family dog. Grampa reveals that Homer himself had a dog as a boy--one that he had to give up.

episodes.title: Homer Goes to Prep School
episodes.overview: A trip to a childrens' playhouse turns into a near-death experience for Homer. He meets preppers who help him get ready for the imminent end of the world.

episodes.title: A Test Before Trying
episodes.overview: Bart must pass a test to save Springfield Elementary. Meanwhile, Homer finds a working parking meter and uses it to steal quarters beyond his wildest dreams.

episodes.title: The Changing of the Guardian
episodes.overview: Marge and Homer nearly suffocate in a revolving door during a tornado. They realize they do not have suitable guardians for their children.

episodes.title: Love Is a Many-Splintered Thing
episodes.overview: Love is a Many-Splintered Thing. Bart looks back at love from middle age in this homage to Annie Hall.

episodes.title: Hardly Kirk-Ing
episodes.overview: Bart and Milhouse discover that they can convince everyone Milhouse is his dad. Meanwhile, Homer discovers a hidden talent for finding hidden pictures.

episodes.title: Gorgeous Grampa
episodes.overview: The Simpsons discover Grampa was a "bad guy" pro wrestler in the '50s. Then they are alarmed to see Bart begin to adopt Grampa's worst qualities.

episodes.title: Black Eyed, Please
episodes.overview: Lisa gets picked on by a bully who happens to be her teacher, and cannot figure out the reason why. Meanwhile, Flanders finally gets fed up and punches Homer in the eye--then desperately begs his neighboreeno for forgiveness Homer won't provide.

episodes.title: Dark Knight Court
episodes.overview: Springfield's Easter is ruined by a prank and all fingers point to Bart. It is up to Lisa to save her brother, in a student court presided over by Attorney General Janet Reno. Meanwhile, inspired by an old comic book, Mr. Burns becomes an ineffectual superhero--fruit bat man.

episodes.title: What Animated Women Want
episodes.overview: Homer learns the four f's of dealing with women while Milhouse discovers the secret to Lisa's heart.

episodes.title: Pulpit Friction
episodes.overview: After a terrifying bedbug scare, a new teacher comes to Springfield Presbylutheran and wins the congregation's affections--sending Reverend Lovejoy into the unholy world of hot tub sales.

episodes.title: Whiskey Business
episodes.overview: A suicide attempt gone awry prompts Marge to buy Moe a fancy new suit to improve his outlook on life. He starts a homemade bourbon brewery and gets an IPO at the Springfield stock exchange -- then loses the suit that got him there.

episodes.title: The Fabulous Faker Boy
episodes.overview: Bart takes piano lessons because his teacher is a beautiful young girl. But he disappoints his mother with his lack of talent at a recital.

episodes.title: The Saga of Carl
episodes.overview: When the guys split a winning lottery ticket, they are stunned when Carl disappears with the money. In tracking him down, they discover surprising secrets about his past.

episodes.title: Dangers On a Train
episodes.overview: When Marge tries to buy Homer snack cakes for their anniversary, she winds up meeting a married man who shares a common love of British Television. Ignorant of all, Homer attempts to secretly construct a romantic anniversary train in the Simpsons back yard.

episodes.title: Homerland
episodes.overview: Homer returns from a trip a different man from when he left--which greatly disturbs Lisa. She calls the FBI and uncovers a very surprising plot.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXIV
episodes.overview: The scariest Simpsons Halloween show yet, featuring an opening by Guillermo Del Toro. Also a malicious behatted creature invades the Simpson home, Bart's head finds a new pair of shoulders and Homer and Marge join a circus full of freaks.

episodes.title: Four Regrettings and a Funeral
episodes.overview: At the funeral of a man who Springfield loved but we’ve never met, Homer, Marge, Burns and Brockman express their regrets.

episodes.title: YOLO
episodes.overview: Homer is stunned to learn he'll only live once. A pen pal from his youth helps him live that life to its fullest. Meanwhile Springfield Elementary institutes an honor code.

episodes.title: Labor Pains
episodes.overview: Homer helps deliver a baby in an elevator and grows close to the child. Meanwhile, Lisa helps some professional cheerleaders in their battle for better working conditions.

episodes.title: The Kid Is All Right
episodes.overview: Lisa makes a new best friend--who turns out to be as conservative as Lisa is liberal. When they run against each other for 2nd grade rep, the Springfield Republican Party tries to tip the scales.

episodes.title: Yellow Subterfuge
episodes.overview: When Bart is denied a field trip on a navy sub, Homer plots revenge on Skinner. Meanwhile, Krusty raises money by selling his franchise to foreign clowns.

episodes.title: White Christmas Blues
episodes.overview: When Springfield is the only place in America with snow at Christmas, tourists flock to the town and Marge turns the Simpson home into a bed and breakfast. Meanwhile, Lisa decides to go a different way with her annual holiday gifts.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Homer becomes annoyed with movie theaters, so Bart teaches him how to download movies illegally. Homer is delighted with his discovery of free movies until he’s caught for piracy.

episodes.title: Married to the Blob
episodes.overview: Comic Book Guy realizes his comics are nothing if he can’t share them with anyone. Then he meets Kumiko, a Japanese woman writing an autobiographical manga, and he seeks out Homer’s advice on how to date her, ending happily for everyone.

episodes.title: Specs and the City
episodes.overview: Burns gives out "smart glasses" that enable him to spy on his employees. Bart must come up the perfect Valentine for Neslon the bully.

episodes.title: The Man Who Grew Too Much
episodes.overview: Lisa campaigns against genetically modified organisms. Meanwhile, Marge teaches abstinence counseling to church teens.

episodes.title: Diggs
episodes.overview: Bart befriends a boy and his falcon, then learns the relationship with each is more complicated than he thought.

episodes.title: The Winter of His Content
episodes.overview: Marge invites Grampa and two other octogenarians to live at the Simpsons’ house after the Retirement Castle is closed for health violations, but she quickly becomes frustrated with Homer when he starts embracing the “old person lifestyle.” Meanwhile, at Springfield Elementary, Bart defends Nelson’s affinity for hand-me-down underwear, leading Nelson to befriend Bart.

episodes.title: The War of Art
episodes.overview: After Lisa’s new pet guinea pig destroys the Simpsons’ living room art, Marge falls in love with a beautiful painting at the Van Houten’s yard sale, which Homer snaps up for 20 bucks. But, when Lisa reveals it’s by a famous early 20th century painter and could be worth $100,000, Marge and Homer face a dilemma: split the money with the Van Houtens, or keep the cash as a “cushion” for their kids.

episodes.title: You Don't Have to Live Like a Referee
episodes.overview: Lisa declares Homer her hero, but he must prove himself while refereeing at the World Cup.

episodes.title: Luca$
episodes.overview: Lisa meets a boy who dreams of becoming a competitive eater. Meanwhile, Homer gets stuck in a playground slide.

episodes.title: Days of Future Future
episodes.overview: 30 years in the future Lisa is married to a zombie and Homer is just a face on a screen. Bart is willing to rewire his brain to forget his ex-wife.

episodes.title: What to Expect When Bart's Expecting
episodes.overview: When Bart puts a voodoo curse on a teacher, she gets pregnant and childless couples turn to him for help. Then Fat Tony "asks" him to breed a champion thoroughbred.

episodes.title: Brick Like Me
episodes.overview: In the Simpsons' 550th episode, Homer enters a blocky world of dreams. Will he ever again become his normal 2D self?

episodes.title: Pay Pal
episodes.overview: Marge wants couples friends, but Homer destroys their chances. She decides to focus on helping Lisa make friends.

episodes.title: The Yellow Badge of Cowardge
episodes.overview: At field day, Bart undergoes a test of courage that he fails miserably.  And when the town cancels fireworks on the Fourth of July, Homer tries to fill the gap.

episodes.title: Clown in the Dumps
episodes.overview: A death in Springfield has serious repercussions.

episodes.title: The Wreck of the Relationship
episodes.overview: Bart and Homer stage a titanic struggle over a piece of broccoli. They try to repair their relationship on a father/son cruise.

episodes.title: Super Franchise Me
episodes.overview: Marge manages a fast-food sandwich franchise but runs into disaster when the chain lets the Spucklers open an outlet across the street.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXV
episodes.overview: Bart goes to school in Hell, and the house is haunted by the Tracey Ullman Show Simpsons.

episodes.title: Opposites A-Frack
episodes.overview: When fire bursts through the Simpsons' water supply, they discover Mr. Burns has been extracting shale oil from the ground below. To politically support his actions, Burns woos a liberal congresswoman.

episodes.title: Simpsorama
episodes.overview: The long-awaited Simpsons/Futurama crossover. The Planet Express crew travels back in time to discover, and kill, the present-day Simpson who has ruined the future.

episodes.title: Blazed and Confused
episodes.overview: Bart gets a psychotic new teacher. The Simpsons find themselves trapped at a poor man's Burning Man.

episodes.title: Covercraft
episodes.overview: Homer forms a cover band with other dads in the neighborhood. Then frontman Apu is poached.

episodes.title: I Won't Be Home for Christmas
episodes.overview: A needy Moe keeps Homer late at the bar on Christmas Eve and Marge won't let him come home. Homer embarks on a Christmas Eve odyssey of Springfield's lonely denizens.

episodes.title: The Man Who Came to Be Dinner
episodes.overview: The Simpsons visit the home planet of aliens Kang and Kodos. Homer must make the ultimate sacrifice to save his family.

episodes.title: Bart's New Friend
episodes.overview: Homer regresses to the mind of a ten year old and becomes Bart's best friend. Bart learns that his father is sweeter and cooler than he ever knew.

episodes.title: The Musk Who Fell to Earth
episodes.overview: Tesla founder Elon Musk lands in Springfield and magically transforms the town into a dystopia. His business partner, Mr. Burns, is ruined and seeks revenge.

episodes.title: Walking Big & Tall
episodes.overview: A group of wide priders teach Homer it's okay to be plus sized. Meanwhile, Lisa and Bart write a new anthem for Springfield.

episodes.title: My Fare Lady
episodes.overview: Marge starts driving for pay but runs afoul of Springfield's cabbies.  Meanwhile, Moe's Tavern is destroyed on Ladies’ Night.

episodes.title: The Princess Guide
episodes.overview: Moe befriends a Nigerian princess whose father has come to make a uranium deal with Mr. Burns. Meanwhile Smithers hopes to retire with Burns to a South Sea Island.

episodes.title: Sky Police
episodes.overview: Chief Wiggum accidentally gets a jet pack. Meanwhile, the First Church of Springfield turns to card counting to make money.

episodes.title: Waiting for Duffman
episodes.overview: When Springfield's resident Duffman is forced to retire, Homer is thrilled to get the job. Amazingly he doesn't keep it!

episodes.title: Peeping Mom
episodes.overview: When Marge suspects Bart isn't being honest with her, she becomes a relentless mother. Meanwhile Flanders gets a new dog that loves Homer.

episodes.title: The Kids Are All Fight
episodes.overview: Four-year-old Bart and two-year-old Lisa can't stop fighting, much to their parents' dismay.

episodes.title: Let's Go Fly a Coot
episodes.overview: Members of Grampa's World War II unit attempt to teach Homer respect for his father. Meanwhile Bart gets addicted to kid-friendly e-cigarettes.

episodes.title: Bull-E
episodes.overview: Marge's attempt to ban bullying lands half the town in jail. Homer must address the way he has treated Ned Flanders.

episodes.title: Mathlete's Feat
episodes.overview: Springfield Elementary loses its electronic devices and becomes a Waldorf school. Willie becomes math team coach and the meet-clinching puzzle has a surprising solution.

episodes.title: Every Man's Dream
episodes.overview: Homer is diagnosed with narcolepsy, but instead of returning home with his prescription medication, he returns home drunk. He and Marge visit a marriage counselor and have a trial separation, during which Homer begins dating a 20-something.

episodes.title: 'Cue Detective
episodes.overview: Scotty Boom, a Chew Network super-chef, challenges Homer to a smoke-off. But when someone steals Homer’s secret weapon – a smoker he bought off a mysterious man at a BBQ shack – Lisa and Bart are on the case.

episodes.title: Puffless
episodes.overview: Marge's sisters vow to quit smoking but one quickly succumbs.  Maggie befriends the animals on the roof and must save an opossum from Cletus' kitchen.

episodes.title: Halloween of Horror
episodes.overview: In this "real" Halloween episode the Simpsons go to a terrifying theme park.  Lisa becomes afraid of Halloween and then home invaders attack the Simpson house.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXVI
episodes.overview: In the annual fright fest Halloween episode, Sideshow Bob finally kills Bart, only to reanimate him; Homer wakes up with short-term memory loss; and Lisa, Bart, and Milhouse get super powers from radiation.

episodes.title: Friend with Benefit
episodes.overview: Lisa befriends Harper, a new kid at school who happens to be super-rich. Then, Homer befriends Harper’s dad and is able to enjoy the perks of Lisa having a rich friend, as well. But Lisa decides that Harper is a bully and moves to end the friendship, which prompts Homer to try and smooth things over so he can continue to enjoy the good life.

episodes.title: Lisa with an 'S'
episodes.overview: When Homer loses $5,000 at a poker game with Broadway legend Laney Fontaine, the only way he is able to settle the bet is if he loans Lisa to Laney for a month. Then, Laney turns Lisa into a show biz kid and Marge and Homer fear they made a mistake letting her go. So they head to New York to get her back.

episodes.title: 'Paths of Glory
episodes.overview: Lisa tries to save the reputation of a local female inventor.

episodes.title: Barthood
episodes.overview: Bart’s coming of age story a la “Boyhood” chronicles his life from six years old to his time as an accomplished young man. Along the way, his tense relationship with Homer, an overly uncaring version of himself, and Lisa, who overshadows him in every way possible, shape Bart more than he realizes.

episodes.title: The Girl Code
episodes.overview: Lisa creates artificial intelligence when she designs her own app.  Meanwhile Homer realizes he was happiest in life working as a dishwasher in a Greek diner.

episodes.title: Teenage Mutant Milk-Caused Hurdles
episodes.overview: Bart grows a starter mustache and gets a crush on his new teacher. Then he discovers Principal Skinner is in love with her too.

episodes.title: Much Apu About Something
episodes.overview: Sanjay passes his stake in the Kwik-E-Mart to his millennial son, Jay, who turns it into a hip, health food market against Apu’s insistence on tradition. Bart, whom Homer had convinced to give up pranking, is called upon to return to his trickster life and take down the new store.

episodes.title: Love Is in the N2-O2-Ar-Co2-Ne-He-Ch4
episodes.overview: On Valentine’s Day, Professor Frink attempts to uncover the secret to women; Marge worries about the seniors at Grampa’s nursing home when she realizes they only experience love while under the influence of medication.

episodes.title: Gal of Constant Sorrow
episodes.overview: After Bart accidentally sends a homeless woman’s cart into the river, he allows her to live in his closet for a fee. When Lisa discovers the woman is an incredible folk singer, she offers her own closet and plans a concert, only to be disappointed by Hettie’s substance abuse and violent nature. Meanwhile Homer tries to prove he’s handy, but accidentally traps the cat in the walls of the house.

episodes.title: Lisa the Veterinarian
episodes.overview: Lisa interns for a veterinarian.

episodes.title: The Marge-Ian Chronicles
episodes.overview: Not feeling unique, Lisa signs up for the Mars One Space Colony – to Marge’s dismay. Then, Marge hires Bart to go through the tryout process with Lisa to make her want to quit.

episodes.title: The Burns Cage
episodes.overview: When Smithers is devastated by Burns’ lack of affection towards him, Homer makes it his mission to find him a boyfriend. Meanwhile, after Bart orchestrates the removal of the lead in the school’s stage production of “Casablanca,” Milhouse serves as a terrible understudy, which frustrates his co-star, Lisa.

episodes.title: How Lisa Got Her Marge Back
episodes.overview: After getting into an argument, Marge takes Lisa on a touristy trip to Capital City, where, after attending a musical, they meet the show’s star, Andrew Rannells, who reminds Lisa how lucky she is to have such a great mom. Meanwhile, Bart is frustrated that everyone expects his pranks, so he teams up with Maggie to trick people.

episodes.title: Fland Canyon
episodes.overview: Homer recalls a tense family vacation to the Grand Canyon with the Flanders family. At first, the Flanders’ perfection puts the families at odds, but when they get stranded and Ned and Bart go for help, the families finally bond.

episodes.title: To Courier with Love
episodes.overview: After promising Marge the trip of a lifetime, frugality gets the better of Homer when he makes a deal with a travel agent to be a courier of a top-secret briefcase in exchange for a discounted family vacation to Paris.

episodes.title: Simprovised
episodes.overview: After butchering a speech in front of his friends at work, Homer turns to improv comedy to gain back his confidence in his public speaking skills.  Meanwhile, Marge decides to rebuild Bart’s lackluster treehouse, but tensions rise when Bart questions her building skills.

episodes.title: Orange Is the New Yellow
episodes.overview: When Marge gets arrested for letting Bart go to the park unsupervised, she serves time only to realize that prison is a welcome break from the demands of her life as a mom and wife. In her absence, Homer struggles to manage all of the parenting responsibilities that Marge usually handles.

episodes.title: Monty Burns' Fleeing Circus
episodes.overview: When Springfield is burned to the ground, the Simpsons beg Mr. Burns to fund its rebuilding. Burns agrees – with one condition: he gets to put on a variety show at the Springfield Bowl.

episodes.title: Friends and Family
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns hires the Simpsons to play his live-in virtual reality family, but excludes Homer so that he may play dad. Now alone, Homer finds a new best friend in girl-next-door Julia, who eats, drinks and thinks like him.

episodes.title: The Town
episodes.overview: The Simpsons go on a hate-cation.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXVII
episodes.overview: In the midst of a major drought, Mr. Burns introduces a Hunger Games-style contest in which Springfield’s children fight each other for a day in Burns’ personal reservoir. Meanwhile, Lisa’s imaginary best friend, Rachel, is jealous of Lisa’s real best friends and starts killing them. Moe tells Bart that the barflies are actually covert agents and that Bart should join their team in Homer’s place.

episodes.title: Trust but Clarify
episodes.overview: Kent Brockman is fired for stretching the truth.  Meanwhile Bart and Lisa investigate Krusty's suspicious new snack.

episodes.title: There Will Be Buds
episodes.overview: Kirk and Homer coach lacrosse. This leads to a falling out where Homer must find a sad, lonely Kirk.

episodes.title: Havana Wild Weekend
episodes.overview: The Simpsons look to Cuba for better medical care for Grampa.  He is rejuvenated by riding the perfectly preserved 1950s cars in Havana.

episodes.title: Dad Behavior
episodes.overview: Homer finds an app that does all his chores for him.  Having outsourced his fatherly duties, he finds he is losing Bart from his life.

episodes.title: The Last Traction Hero
episodes.overview: Homer's injuries leave Marge lonely for companionship.

episodes.title: The Nightmare After Krustmas
episodes.overview: Krusty tries to impress his daughter as they spend Christmas with the Simpsons. Meanwhile, Reverend Lovejoy seeks converts after church attendance plummets, and Maggie is haunted by a spooky Christmas toy.

episodes.title: Pork and Burns
episodes.overview: Marge adopts a Japanese system for tidiness.   Homer gets a service animal also known as...the amazing spider pig.

episodes.title: The Great Phatsby (Vol. I & Vol. II)
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns meets a hip hop mogul.

episodes.title: Fatzcarraldo
episodes.overview: Homer rediscovers a chili dog joint he loved as a kid. When it closes he takes it on a quixotic freeway chase through Springfield.

episodes.title: Fatzcarraldo
episodes.overview: Homer rediscovers a chili dog joint he loved as a kid.

episodes.title: The Cad and the Hat
episodes.overview: Lisa gets a new hat that boosts her self confidence.  So Bart makes the hat disappear.

episodes.title: Kamp Krustier
episodes.overview: The Simpsons return to Kamp Krusty to cure the children's trauma.  Homer discovers abstinence makes him incredibly productive.

episodes.title: 22 for 30
episodes.overview: Bart becomes involved in a point shaving scandal in a parody of the "30 for 30" films. Only intervention from an unexpected source can save him.

episodes.title: A Father's Watch
episodes.overview: Homer opens a trophy store to cater to overpraised kids. Meanwhile Bart gets a treasured watch from Grampa.

episodes.title: The Caper Chase
episodes.overview: Frustrated by efforts to start a nuclear training program at Yale, Mr. Burns starts his own university. Homer becomes a star teacher and goes to work for a mysterious billionaire.

episodes.title: Looking for Mr. Goodbart
episodes.overview: Bart befriends generous elderly ladies while Lisa and Homer get caught up in a Pokémon Go style game. Then one of Bart's elderly friends goes missing and he needs Lisa to help find her.

episodes.title: Moho House
episodes.overview: Moe is bankrolled to open a swanky private club. It clarifies once and for all his relationship with Homer and Midge, er Marge.

episodes.title: Dogtown
episodes.overview: Homer must choose between his dog and ol' Gil. Of course he chooses his dog, and his act inspires Springfield to become the dog-friendliest town in America.

episodes.title: The Serfsons
episodes.overview: In a world of fantasy the peasant Simpson family struggles with Marge's mother's illness.

episodes.title: Springfield Splendor
episodes.overview: Lisa and Marge team up on a graphic novel which becomes a musical. Marge receives all the credit and Lisa is humiliated.

episodes.title: Whistler's Father
episodes.overview: Maggie reveals a hidden talent and Grampa tries to exploit it. Marge gets a job as a decorator for the mob.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXVIII
episodes.overview: The Simpsons become Halloween candy; Maggie requires an exorcism; Lisa gets a better life if buttons are sewn on her eyes and Homer discovers the most delicious food of all.

episodes.title: Grampy Can Ya Hear Me
episodes.overview: Grampa gets a hearing aid which tells him more about the world than he wants to know. Skinner learns that his mother shattered his boyhood dream.

episodes.title: The Old Blue Mayor She Ain't What She Used to Be
episodes.overview: After the ancient Springfield monorail runs amok, Marge becomes mayor and vows to put out the long-burning tire fire.

episodes.title: Singin' in the Lane
episodes.overview: Homer's bowling team reunites. Their friendship is tested with Moe, their coach.

episodes.title: Mr. Lisa's Opus
episodes.overview: A look at Lisa's life from talking toddler to college-bound. Plus Homer enters a 12-step plan.

episodes.title: Gone Boy
episodes.overview: Bart disappears and the whole town can't find him. Then he is located by a vengeful Sideshow Bob.

episodes.title: Haw-Haw Land
episodes.overview: Lisa meets a jazz-addicted boy and must choose between him and Nelson. Meanwhile, Bart takes up chemistry, but to what end?

episodes.title: Frink Gets Testy
episodes.overview: Burns fears the end of the world and builds a cosmic ark. When he tests the town for worthiness, Marge is dismayed when Bart comes out on the bottom.

episodes.title: Homer Is Where the Art Isn't
episodes.overview: Homer learns to love a piece of art. Then it's stolen and he's blamed.

episodes.title: 3 Scenes Plus a Tag from a Marriage
episodes.overview: The Simpsons visit their old apartment and remember the days without their kids. And we learn a surprising secret from Lisa's birth.

episodes.title: Fears of a Clown
episodes.overview: Due to a general fear of clowns, Krusty can no longer do his job. He tries to get work as a serious actor.  Meanwhile Bart undergoes therapy for serial pranking.

episodes.title: No Good Read Goes Unpunished

2569.title: Pawn Stars

episodes.title: S01:E01 - Boom or Bust

episodes.title: S01:E07 - Brothels and Busses
episodes.overview: A young man wants to trade a 1750 Blunderbuss gun for an engagement ring.

episodes.title: S01:E08 - Time Machines
episodes.overview: Rick tries to refurbish a 1950's coke machine into a modernized collector's item. Will his plan quench his thirst or fizzle out and go flat? Meanwhile, Corey is offered an old pirate favorite: an 18th Century flintlock pistol.

episodes.title: S01:E09 - Rope a Dope
episodes.overview: The Pawn Stars look to buy a 1929 Chopped Ford Coupe but if they can't agree on a price, will the deal end up rusting in the bone yard? Then, a cowboy wants to sell his mechanical calf-roping machine.

episodes.title: S01:E10 - Rick's Big Bet
episodes.overview: In this episode, Rick refurbishes a gas pump with a bird's nest inside, Corey takes a quiz after misidentifying a Faberge crystal glass.

episodes.title: S01:E11 - John Hancock's Hancock
episodes.overview: The Pawn Stars are used to paying big money for celebrity John Hancocks but will they know how to price one from the actual John Hancock?

episodes.title: S01:E12 - Plane Crazy
episodes.overview: The Pawn Stars travel back in time over two centuries to colonial Boston but is this seller's map the real deal or will the guys tell him to take a hike.

episodes.title: S01:E15 - Fired Up
episodes.overview: The Pawn Stars want to buy an airplane propeller that may be historically tied to Charles Lindbergh--can they find an expert or documentation to confirm the link or will this deal crash and burn?

episodes.title: S01:E16 - Sharks and Cobras
episodes.overview: Rick and the Old Man look to buy a 1965 Shelby Cobra classic car--one of the most expensive American race cars.

episodes.title: S01:E17 - Old Man's Booty
episodes.overview: The Pawn Stars have an opportunity to buy a 17th Century treasure chest that nobody can open--even though what's inside could make all the difference. Will they figure out how to get in and plunder what's inside or will it remain locked?

episodes.title: S01:E18 - A Shot and a Shave
episodes.overview: In this episode, Rick is offered some of the craziest items ever to enter the store, everything from a pricey patchwork quilt made from celebrity autographs to an 1845 Harpers Ferry musket, one with a vintage surprise.

episodes.title: S01:E19 - Hot Air Buffoon
episodes.overview: The pawn shop heats up after Corey spends big bucks buying a huge 12 passenger hot air balloon--and at the same time breaking one of Rick's golden rules.

episodes.title: S01:E20 - Steaks at Stake
episodes.overview: When the Old Man gets concerned about shrinking profits, he offers a steak dinner and a cash prize as an incentive to boost the numbers.

episodes.title: S01:E21 - A Christmas Special
episodes.overview: Celebrate the holidays Pawn Stars style as the Old Man surprises the gang with a special holiday treat.

episodes.title: S01:E22 - Secret Santa
episodes.overview: It's Christmas at the Pawn Shop--time to find out who's been naughty, who's been nice, who's dressed as Santa and who pays the price.

episodes.title: S01:E23 - Pawn Shop Pinot
episodes.overview: When Rick and the Old Man buy an antique 19th Century wine-maker, Chumlee wants to put it into action. Will he succeed and brew a magnificent "Pawn Shop Pinot"?

episodes.title: S01:E24 - Bikes and Blades
episodes.overview: Rick has a chance to buy a 1940 quartermasters spyglass that may be from a WWII ship. Can he discover the ship it came from, or will this deal sink?
